452: func (n *sros) DeployEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
453: 	if err := n.DefaultNode.DeployEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
454: 		return err
455: 	}
456: 
457: 	return n.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx)
458: }
459: 
460: // PostDeployEndpoints runs SR-SIM endpoint fixups after dataplane links exist.
461: func (n *sros) PostDeployEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
462: 	if n.Runtime.Mgmt().Driver == clabtypes.MgmtDriverMacvlan {
463: 		return nil
464: 	}
465: 	// Disable TX checksum offload on the host NS veth for the mgmt interface.
466: 	var peerIfIndex int
467: 	err := n.ExecFunction(ctx, clabutils.VethPeerIndex("eth0", &peerIfIndex))
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		log.Warn("Failed to get veth peer index for SR-SIM mgmt interface",
470: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName,
471: 			"error", err)
472: 		return nil
473: 	}
474: 
475: 	if err := clabutils.DisableTxOffloadByIndex(peerIfIndex); err != nil {
476: 		log.Warn("Failed to disable TX checksum offload on SR-SIM mgmt host veth",
477: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName,
478: 			"error", err)
479: 	}
480: 
481: 	return nil
482: }
483: 
484: // Post Deploy func for SR-SIM kind.
485: func (n *sros) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {
486: 	log.Info("Running postdeploy actions",
487: 		"kind", n.Cfg.Kind,
488: 		"node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
489: 
490: 	// start waiting for container ready (PID based check)
491: 	if err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {
492: 		return err
493: 	}
494: 
495: 	errChan := make(chan error, 1)
496: 
497: 	logs, err := n.Runtime.StreamLogs(ctx, n.GetContainerName())
498: 	if err != nil {
499: 		log.Debug("Failed to get container log stream", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "err", err)
500: 	} else {
501: 		// Start monitoring in a goroutine
502: 		monitoringCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
503: 		defer cancel()
504: 		defer logs.Close()
505: 
506: 		go n.MonitorLogs(monitoringCtx, logs, errChan)
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface
510: 	if err = n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {
511: 		log.Warn("Unable to populate hosts list", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "err", err)
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	n.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)
515: 	if err != nil {
516: 		return err
517: 	}
518: 	if !n.isCPM(slotAName) {
519: 		return nil
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	if err := n.RequireMgmtReachable(); err != nil {
523: 		return err
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	// Execute SaveConfig after boot. This code should only run on active CPM
527: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(readyTimeout)
528: 	var lastHealthErr error
529: 	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
530: 		// Check if context is canceled
531: 		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
532: 			return fmt.Errorf("context canceled: %w", err)
533: 		}
534: 
535: 		isHealthy, err := n.IsHealthy(ctx)
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			lastHealthErr = err
538: 			log.Debug(
539: 				fmt.Errorf(
540: 					"health check failed, check 'docker logs -f %s': %w",
541: 					n.Cfg.LongName,
542: 					err,
543: 				),
544: 			)
545: 		}
546: 
547: 		if isHealthy {
548: 			addr, err := n.MgmtIPAddr()
549: 			if err != nil {
550: 				return err
551: 			}
552: 			// TLS bootstrap in case of n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue flag
553: 			if *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {
554: 				log.Infof("TLS cert/key bootstrap for node %q", n.Cfg.LongName)
555: 
556: 				err = n.tlsCertBootstrap(ctx, addr)
557: 				if err != nil {
558: 					return fmt.Errorf(
559: 						"TLS cert/key bootstrap to node %q failed: %w",
560: 						n.Cfg.LongName,
561: 						err,
562: 					)
563: 				}
564: 				log.Infof(
565: 					"Completed bootstrap for gRPC-TLS profile on node %s",
566: 					n.Cfg.ShortName,
567: 				)
568: 			}
569: 
570: 			// Partial or NO Config Provided
571: 			if !isFullConfigFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig) {
572: 				log.Infof("Saving node %q config as startup...", n.Cfg.LongName)
573: 				err = n.saveConfigWithAddr(ctx, addr)
574: 				if err != nil {
575: 					return fmt.Errorf("save config to node %q, failed: %w", n.Cfg.LongName, err)
576: 				}
577: 			}
578: 			return nil
579: 		}
580: 
581: 		// Wait before next check
582: 		select {
583: 		case <-ctx.Done():
584: 			return ctx.Err()
585: 		case err := <-errChan:
586: 			log.With("kind", n.Cfg.Kind, "node", n.Cfg.ShortName).Debugf("got %q on errChan", err)
587: 			log.Info("Skipping postdeploy actions", "kind", n.Cfg.Kind, "node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
588: 			return nil
589: 		case <-time.After(retryTimer):
590: 			// continue to next iteration
591: 		}
592: 	}
593: 
594: 	if lastHealthErr != nil {
595: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q did not become healthy before timeout: %w",
596: 			n.Cfg.LongName, lastHealthErr)
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	return fmt.Errorf("node %q did not become healthy before timeout", n.Cfg.LongName)
600: }
601: 
602: // Delete func for SR-SIM kind.
603: func (n *sros) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
604: 	// if not distributed, follow default node implementation
605: 	if n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {
606: 		return n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)
607: 	}
608: 
609: 	var errs []error
610: 
611: 	// Delete all the component containers
612: 	for _, componentNode := range n.componentNodes {
613: 		err := componentNode.Delete(ctx)
614: 		if err != nil {
615: 			log.Warn(err)
616: 			errs = append(errs, err)
617: 		}
618: 	}
619: 
620: 	errs = append(errs, n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))
621: 
622: 	return errors.Join(errs...)
623: }
624: 
625: func (n *sros) setupComponentNodes() error {
626: 	if !n.isDistributedBaseNode() {
627: 		return nil
628: 	}
629: 
630: 	n.netnsNode = new(namespaceNode)
631: 	if err := n.netnsNode.Init(
632: 		n.newNetnsConfig(),
633: 		clabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()),
634: 	); err != nil {
635: 		return err
636: 	}
637: 	rootCtrName := n.netnsNode.Config().LongName
638: 
639: 	// loop through the components, creating them
640: 	for _, c := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {
641: 		// instantiate a new nokia_srsim instance
642: 		srosNode := new(sros)
643: 		componentNode := clabnodes.Node(srosNode)
644: 
645: 		// copy the original node's NodeConfig to the component
646: 		componentConfig, err := deep.Copy(n.Cfg)
647: 		if err != nil {
648: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to deep copy node config for component: %w", err)
649: 		}
650: 
651: 		// component nodes join to the nents pause container
652: 		componentConfig.NetworkMode = fmt.Sprintf("container:%s", n.netnsNode.GetShortName())
653: 
654: 		// adjust the config values from the original node
655: 		componentConfig.ShortName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.ShortName, c.Slot)
656: 		componentConfig.LongName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.LongName, c.Slot)
657: 		componentConfig.NodeType = n.Cfg.NodeType
658: 		kindSpecificConfig.Of(componentConfig).Components = nil
659: 		componentConfig.Fqdn = n.calcComponentFqdn(c.Slot)
660: 		componentConfig.DNS = nil
661: 		componentConfig.PortBindings = nil
662: 		componentConfig.PortSet = nil
663: 
664: 		// Component fields fill env keys the user did not set. Node env wins.
665: 		if componentConfig.Env == nil {
666: 			componentConfig.Env = map[string]string{}
667: 		}
668: 		keepUserEnv(n.Cfg.ShortName, componentConfig.Env, componentDerivedEnv(c), n.userEnv)
669: 		// Slot identifies this container. A node-level NOKIA_SROS_SLOT cannot apply to every card.
670: 		componentConfig.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot] = c.Slot
671: 
672: 		// adjust label based env vars
673: 		componentConfig.Env["CLAB_LABEL_"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.NodeName)] = componentConfig.ShortName
674: 		componentConfig.Env["CLAB_LABEL_"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.LongName)] = componentConfig.LongName
675: 
676: 		if componentConfig.Labels == nil {
677: 			componentConfig.Labels = map[string]string{}
678: 		}
679: 
680: 		// adjust labels
681: 		componentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = componentConfig.ShortName
682: 		componentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.LongName] = componentConfig.LongName
683: 		componentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName
684: 		componentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName
685: 
686: 		// Preserve the topology env. Init must not snapshot the merged component env,
687: 		// or config generation would treat component flags as user overrides.
688: 		srosNode.userEnv = maps.Clone(n.userEnv)
689: 
690: 		// init the component
691: 		err = componentNode.Init(componentConfig)
692: 		if err != nil {
693: 			return err
694: 		}
695: 		// set the runtime by copying it from the general node
696: 		componentNode.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime())
697: 
698: 		// store root components for cpms, for config gen
699: 		srosNode.rootComponents = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components
700: 		// store base node name
701: 		srosNode.baseShortName = n.Cfg.ShortName
702: 		srosNode.baseLongName = n.Cfg.LongName
703: 		srosNode.rootCtrName = rootCtrName
704: 
705: 		// store the node in the componentNodes
706: 		n.componentNodes = append(n.componentNodes, componentNode)
707: 	}
708: 	return nil
709: }
710: 
711: // deployFabric deploys the distributed SR-SIM when the `components` key is present.
712: func (n *sros) deployFabric(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
713: 	netnsConfig := n.netnsNode.Config()
714: 
715: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address
716: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto
717: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength
718: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway
719: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address
720: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto
721: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength
722: 	netnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway
723: 
724: 	if err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams); err != nil {
725: 		return fmt.Errorf("deploy network namespace node %q: %w", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	ips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()
729: 	if err != nil {
730: 		return err
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	n.setComponentMgmtEnv(ips)
734: 
735: 	// loop through the components, creating them
736: 	for _, c := range n.componentNodes {
737: 		if err := c.PreDeploy(ctx, n.preDeployParams); err != nil {
738: 			return fmt.Errorf("pre-deploy for component node %q: %w", c.GetShortName(), err)
739: 		}
740: 		// deploy the component
741: 		err := c.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)
742: 		if err != nil {
743: 			return err
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 
747: 	cpmSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()
748: 	if err != nil {
749: 		return err
750: 	}
751: 	// store the CPM container name
752: 	n.cpmContainerName = n.calcComponentName(n.Cfg.LongName, cpmSlot)
753: 	n.renameDone = true
754: 
755: 	// adjust also the mgmt IP addresses of the general node
756: 	n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = ips.IPv4
757: 	n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = ips.IPv6
758: 
759: 	return nil
760: }
761: 
762: // set env vars for the CPMs so that they are aware of mgmt info.
763: func (n *sros) setComponentMgmtEnv(ips MgmtIP) {
764: 	for _, component := range n.componentNodes {
765: 		cfg := component.Config()
766: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot])
767: 
768: 		if slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName {
769: 			continue
770: 		}
771: 
772: 		env := cfg.Env
773: 		if intf := env["NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF"]; intf != "" && intf != "eth0" {
774: 			continue
775: 		}
776: 		if env[envSrosIPv4Active] != "" || env[envSrosIPv6Active] != "" {
777: 			continue
778: 		}
779: 
780: 		// SKIP if the user defines this env var
781: 		explicitRoutes := false
782: 		for key := range env {
783: 			if strings.HasPrefix(key, envSrosStaticRoutePrefix) {
784: 				explicitRoutes = true
785: 				break
786: 			}
787: 		}
788: 		if explicitRoutes {
789: 			continue
790: 		}
791: 
792: 		if ips.IPv4 != "" {
793: 			env[envSrosIPv4Active] = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", ips.IPv4, ips.IPv4pLen)
794: 			if ips.IPv4Gw != "" {
795: 				env[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+"1"] = "0.0.0.0/0@" + ips.IPv4Gw
796: 			}
797: 		}
798: 
799: 		if ips.IPv6 != "" {
800: 			env[envSrosIPv6Active] = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", ips.IPv6, ips.IPv6pLen)
801: 			if ips.IPv6Gw != "" {
802: 				env[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+"2"] = "::/0@" + ips.IPv6Gw
803: 			}
804: 		}
805: 	}
806: }
807: 
808: // isDistributedCard checks if the slot variable is set, hence it is an instance (slot) of a
809: // distributed setup.
810: // isDistributedCardNode returns true if this node is a card (linecard/IOM)
811: // in a distributed SR-SIM deployment. A distributed card has a slot assignment
812: // but no components of its own.
813: func (n *sros) isDistributedCardNode() bool {
814: 	_, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]
815: 	return exists && len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) == 0
816: }
817: 
818: // isDistributedBaseNode returns true if this is the base node of a distributed
819: // SR-SIM deployment. The base node orchestrates multiple component nodes.
820: func (n *sros) isDistributedBaseNode() bool {
821: 	if isIntegratedSrosNodeType(n.Cfg.NodeType) {
822: 		return isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents(n.Cfg.NodeType, n.kindSpecificCfg().Components)
823: 	}
824: 	return len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1
825: }
826: 
827: // isStandaloneNode returns true if this is a standalone (non-distributed) SR-SIM node.
828: func (n *sros) isStandaloneNode() bool {
829: 	return !n.isDistributedBaseNode() && !n.isDistributedCardNode()
830: }
831: 
832: // calcComponentName appends the line card suffix to the given node name.
833: func (n *sros) calcComponentName(name, slot string) string {
834: 	if n.renameDone {
835: 		return name
836: 	}
837: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", name, strings.ToLower(slot))
838: }
839: 
840: // calcComponentFqdn computes the FQDN for a given slot.
841: func (n *sros) calcComponentFqdn(slot string) string {
842: 	if n.renameDone {
843: 		return n.Cfg.Fqdn
844: 	}
845: 	fqdnDotIndex := strings.Index(n.Cfg.Fqdn, ".")
846: 	if fqdnDotIndex < 0 {
847: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", n.Cfg.Fqdn, strings.ToLower(slot))
848: 	}
849: 	result := fmt.Sprintf(
850: 		"%s-%s%s",
851: 		n.Cfg.Fqdn[:fqdnDotIndex],
852: 		strings.ToLower(slot),
853: 		n.Cfg.Fqdn[fqdnDotIndex:],
854: 	)
855: 	return result
856: }
857: 
858: // cpmNode returns a CPM Node (used in Distributed mode).
859: func (n *sros) cpmNode() (clabnodes.Node, error) {
860: 	defaultSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()
861: 	if err != nil {
862: 		return nil, err
863: 	}
864: 	defaultSlot = strings.ToLower(defaultSlot)
865: 	for _, cn := range n.componentNodes {
866: 		if cn.GetShortName()[len(cn.GetShortName())-1:] == defaultSlot {
867: 			return cn, nil
868: 		}
869: 	}
870: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("node %s: node for slot %s not found", n.GetShortName(), defaultSlot)
871: }
872: 
873: // cpmSlot returns the Slot of the preferred CPM Node (used when Distributed mode).
874: // It prefers slot A if present, otherwise returns slot B.
875: func (n *sros) cpmSlot() (string, error) {
876: 	// Prefer slot A, fall back to slot B. Slots are accepted in either case.
877: 	for _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {
878: 		if strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotAName) {
879: 			return slotAName, nil
880: 		}
881: 	}
882: 	for _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {
883: 		if strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotBName) {
884: 			return slotBName, nil
885: 		}
886: 	}
887: 	return "", fmt.Errorf("node %s: unable to determine default slot", n.GetShortName())
888: }

890: // Deploy deploys the SR-SIM kind.
891: func (n *sros) Deploy(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {
892: 	// if it is a chassis with multiple cards (i.e. components)
893: 	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() {
894: 		err := n.deployFabric(ctx, deployParams)
895: 		if err != nil {
896: 			return err
897: 		}
898: 
899: 		// Update the nodes state
900: 		n.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
901: 		return nil
902: 	}
903: 
904: 	// if it is a regular node
905: 	err := n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)
906: 	if err != nil {
907: 		return err
908: 	}
909: 
910: 	return nil
911: }

913: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config
914: // commands
915: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.
916: func (n *sros) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {
917: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)
918: 	defer cancel()
919: 	var err error
920: 	readyCmds := []string{readyCmdCpm, readyCmdBoth, readyCmdIom}
921: 	readyCmdsStrings := []string{"CPM", "BOTH", "IOM"}
922: 	log.Debug("Waiting for SR OS node to boot...", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
923: 	for {
924: 		select {
925: 		case <-ctx.Done():
926: 			return fmt.Errorf(
927: 				"timed out waiting for SR OS node %s to boot: %v",
928: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
929: 				err,
930: 			)
931: 		default:
932: 			// check if cpm is running
933: 			for k, cmd := range readyCmds {
934: 				cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(cmd)
935: 				execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
936: 				if err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {
937: 					logMsg := fmt.Sprintf(
938: 						"status check %s failed on %s retrying",
939: 						readyCmdsStrings[k],
940: 						n.Cfg.ShortName,
941: 					)
942: 					if err != nil {
943: 						logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(" error: %v", err)
944: 					}
945: 					if execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {
946: 						logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(
947: 							", output:%s",
948: 							strings.ReplaceAll(execResult.String(), "\n", "; "),
949: 						)
950: 					}
951: 					log.Debug(logMsg)
952: 				}
953: 				if execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() == 0 {
954: 					log.Debug("SR OS is ready to be configured", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
955: 					return nil
956: 				}
957: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
958: 			}
959: 		}
960: 	}
961: }

963: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.
964: func (*sros) checkKernelVersion() error {
965: 	// retrieve running kernel version
966: 	kv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()
967: 	if err != nil {
968: 		return err
969: 	}
970: 
971: 	// do the comparison
972: 	if !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {
973: 		log.Warnf(
974: 			"Nokia SR OS requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s. Not all features might function properly!",
975: 			requiredKernelVersion,
976: 			kv,
977: 		)
978: 	}
979: 	return nil
980: }

982: func (n *sros) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {
983: 	// perform the sros specific kernel version check
984: 	err := n.checkKernelVersion()
985: 	if err != nil {
986: 		return err
987: 	}
988: 
989: 	// check the sros component slot config for validaity
990: 	err = n.checkComponentSlotsConfig()
991: 	if err != nil {
992: 		return err
993: 	}
994: 
995: 	return n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)
996: }

998: // Func that creates the Dirs used for the kind SR-SIM and sets/merges the default Env vars.
999: func (n *sros) createSROSFiles(ctx context.Context) error {
1000: 	log.Debug("Creating directory structure for SR OS container", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
1001: 
1002: 	var err error
1003: 
1004: 	if n.Cfg.License != "" && (n.isCPM("") || n.isStandaloneNode()) {
1005: 		// copy license file to node specific directory in lab
1006: 		licPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "license.key")
1007: 		if err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), n.Cfg.License, licPath,
1008: 			clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {
1009: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1010: 				"license copying src %s -> dst %s failed: %v",
1011: 				n.Cfg.License,
1012: 				licPath,
1013: 				err,
1014: 			)
1015: 		}
1016: 		log.Debug("SR OS license copied", "src", n.Cfg.License, "dst", licPath)
1017: 	}
1018: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]),
1019: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1020: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], "config"),
1021: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1022: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf1),
1023: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1024: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf2),
1025: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1026: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3),
1027: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1028: 	if err := n.writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx); err != nil {
1029: 		log.Debug("Didn't write chassis_info.json to lab dir. Docker version is likely too new.",
1030: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "path", n.Cfg.LabDir, "error", err)
1031: 	}
1032: 	if n.isCPM(slotAName) || n.isStandaloneNode() {
1033: 		err = n.createSROSCertificates()
1034: 	}
1035: 	if err != nil {
1036: 		return err
1037: 	}
1038: 	// Skip config if node is not CPM
1039: 	if n.isCPM("") || n.isStandaloneNode() {
1040: 		err = n.createSROSConfigFiles()
1041: 		if err != nil {
1042: 			return err
1043: 		}
1044: 	}
1045: 	return nil
1046: }

1048: // writeChassisInfoToLabDir fetches /opt/nokia/chassis_info.json from the node image
1049: // (via graph driver, same as srosVersionFromImage) and writes it under n.Cfg.LabDir
1050: // with the same filename (chassis_info.json).
1051: func (n *sros) writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx context.Context) error {
1052: 	imageInspect, err := n.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, n.Cfg.Image)
1053: 	if err != nil {
1054: 		return fmt.Errorf("inspect image: %w", err)
1055: 	}
1056: 	content, err := ReadFileFromImageInspect(imageInspect, DefaultChassisInfoPath)
1057: 	if err != nil {
1058: 		return err
1059: 	}
1060: 	dstPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, filepath.Base(DefaultChassisInfoPath))
1061: 	licensed := append([]byte(chassisInfoFileLicense), content...)
1062: 	if err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, licensed, clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {
1063: 		return fmt.Errorf("write %s: %w", dstPath, err)
1064: 	}
1065: 	log.Debug("Wrote chassis_info.json to lab dir", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "path", dstPath)
1066: 	n.warnUnsupportedComponents(content)
1067: 	return nil
1068: }

1070: // warnUnsupportedComponents validates the effective component configuration against the
1071: // chassis_info.json extracted from this exact image. Validation is advisory and never blocks
1072: // deploy.
1073: func (n *sros) warnUnsupportedComponents(content []byte) {
1074: 	// A distributed node validates once, from CPM A, to avoid duplicate warnings from CPM B.
1075: 	if !n.isStandaloneNode() && !n.isCPM(slotAName) {
1076: 		return
1077: 	}
1078: 
1079: 	info, err := parseChassisInfo(content)
1080: 	if err != nil {
1081: 		log.Warn("Could not validate SR-SIM components against chassis_info.json",
1082: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "error", err)
1083: 		return
1084: 	}
1085: 
1086: 	components := n.rootComponents
1087: 	if len(components) == 0 {
1088: 		components = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components
1089: 	}
1090: 
1091: 	effective := n.componentsForConfig(components)
1092: 	if len(effective) == 0 {
1093: 		// Environment variables can configure integrated hardware without a components entry.
1094: 		effective = []*Component{n.componentForConfig(nil)}
1095: 	}
1096: 
1097: 	nodeType := n.Cfg.NodeType
1098: 	if chassis := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosChassis]); chassis != "" {
1099: 		nodeType = chassis
1100: 	}
1101: 	for _, warning := range info.componentWarnings(nodeType, n.componentSFM(), effective) {
1102: 		log.Warn("SR-SIM component configuration may not be supported",
1103: 			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName,
1104: 			"chassis", nodeType,
1105: 			"warning", warning)
1106: 	}
1107: }

1109: // Func that Places the Certificates in the right place and format.
1110: func (n *sros) createSROSCertificates() error {
1111: 	if *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {
1112: 		clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3),
1113: 			clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
1114: 		keyPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3, tlsKeyFile)
1115: 		if err := clabutils.CreateFile(keyPath, n.Config().TLSKey); err != nil {
1116: 			return err
1117: 		}
1118: 
1119: 		certPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3, tlsCertFile)
1120: 		err := clabutils.CreateFile(certPath, n.Config().TLSCert)
1121: 		if err != nil {
1122: 			return err
1123: 		}
1124: 	}
1125: 	return nil
1126: }

1128: // SlotIsInteger checks if the slot string represents a valid integer.
1129: func SlotIsInteger(s string) bool {
1130: 	_, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
1131: 	return err == nil
1132: }
1133: 
1134: // Check if a container is a CPM.
1135: // isCPM checks if a container is a CPM (Control Processing Module).
1136: // Returns false if the slot is a linecard (integer slot).
1137: // If a specific CPM name is provided, returns false if this is a different CPM.
1138: func (n *sros) isCPM(cpm string) bool {
1139: 	slot, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]
1140: 	if !exists {
1141: 		// No slot specified - this is a CPM
1142: 		return true
1143: 	}
1144: 
1145: 	// If slot is an integer, it's a linecard, not a CPM
1146: 	if SlotIsInteger(slot) {
1147: 		return false
1148: 	}
1149: 
1150: 	// Slot is non-integer (CPM slot). If a specific CPM was requested,
1151: 	// check if this is that CPM
1152: 	if cpm != "" && !strings.EqualFold(slot, cpm) {
1153: 		return false
1154: 	}
1155: 
1156: 	return true
1157: }

1159: func (n *sros) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
1160: 	// if not a distributed setup call regular GetContainers
1161: 	if n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {
1162: 		return n.DefaultNode.GetContainers(ctx)
1163: 	}
1164: 
1165: 	cpmSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()
1166: 	if err != nil {
1167: 		return nil, err
1168: 	}
1169: 	containerName := n.calcComponentName(n.GetContainerName(), cpmSlot)
1170: 
1171: 	cnts, err := n.Runtime.ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
1172: 		{
1173: 			FilterType: "name",
1174: 			Match:      containerName,
1175: 		},
1176: 	})
1177: 	if err != nil {
1178: 		return nil, err
1179: 	}
1180: 	// check that we retrieved some container information
1181: 	// otherwise throw ErrContainersNotFound error
1182: 	if len(cnts) == 0 {
1183: 		// check for the netns holder as to never orphan it.
1184: 		if n.netnsNode != nil {
1185: 			return n.netnsNode.GetContainers(ctx)
1186: 		}
1187: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("node: %s. %w", n.GetContainerName(),
1188: 			clabnodes.ErrContainersNotFound)
1189: 	}
1190: 
1191: 	// Forge the IP address to be the actual IP of mgmt
1192: 	// because the CPM A might not own the netns & mgmt IP
1193: 	if len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 0 {
1194: 		ips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()
1195: 		if err == nil {
1196: 			if ips.IPv4 != "" {
1197: 				cnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr = ips.IPv4
1198: 				cnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv4pLen = ips.IPv4pLen
1199: 			}
1200: 			if ips.IPv6 != "" {
1201: 				cnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr = ips.IPv6
1202: 				cnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv6pLen = ips.IPv6pLen
1203: 			}
1204: 		}
1205: 	}
1206: 
1207: 	return cnts, err
1208: }
1209: 
1210: // populateHosts adds container hostnames for other nodes of a lab to SR Linux /etc/hosts file
1211: // to mitigate the fact that srlinux uses non default netns for management and thus
1212: // can't leverage docker DNS service.
1213: func (n *sros) populateHosts(ctx context.Context, nodes map[string]clabnodes.Node) error {
1214: 	containerName := n.Cfg.LongName
1215: 	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() && n.cpmContainerName != "" {
1216: 		containerName = n.cpmContainerName
1217: 	}
1218: 
1219: 	hosts, err := n.Runtime.GetHostsPath(ctx, containerName)
1220: 	if err != nil {
1221: 		log.Warn("Unable to locate SR OS node /etc/hosts file", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "err", err)
1222: 		return err
1223: 	}
1224: 	var entriesv4, entriesv6 bytes.Buffer
1225: 	const (
1226: 		v4Prefix = "###### CLAB-v4-START ######"
1227: 		v4Suffix = "###### CLAB-v4-END ######"
1228: 		v6Prefix = "###### CLAB-v6-START ######"
1229: 		v6Suffix = "###### CLAB-v6-END ######"
1230: 	)
1231: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "\n%s\n", v4Prefix)
1232: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "\n%s\n", v6Prefix)
1233: 	for node, params := range nodes {
1234: 		if v4 := params.Config().MgmtIPv4Address; v4 != "" {
1235: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\t%s\n", v4, node)
1236: 		}
1237: 		if v6 := params.Config().MgmtIPv6Address; v6 != "" {
1238: 			fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\t%s\n", v6, node)
1239: 		}
1240: 	}
1241: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, "%s\n", v4Suffix)
1242: 	fmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, "%s\n", v6Suffix)
1243: 
1244: 	file, err := os.OpenFile(hosts, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o666) // skipcq: GSC-G302
1245: 	if err != nil {
1246: 		log.Warn("Unable to open SR OS node /etc/hosts file", "node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "err", err)
1247: 		return err
1248: 	}
1249: 
1250: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv4.Bytes())
1251: 	if err != nil {
1252: 		return err
1253: 	}
1254: 	_, err = file.Write(entriesv6.Bytes())
1255: 	if err != nil {
1256: 		return err
1257: 	}
1258: 
1259: 	return file.Close()
1260: }
1261: 
1262: func (n *sros) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {
1263: 	captureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(n.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)
1264: 	if err != nil {
1265: 		return "", err
1266: 	}
1267: 
1268: 	indexGroups := []string{"card", "xiom", "mda", "connector", "port"}
1269: 	parsedIndices := make(map[string]int)
1270: 	foundIndices := make(map[string]bool)
1271: 
1272: 	for _, indexKey := range indexGroups {
1273: 		if index, found := captureGroups[indexKey]; found && index != "" {
1274: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = true
1275: 			parsedIndices[indexKey], err = strconv.Atoi(index)
1276: 			if err != nil {
1277: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1278: 					"%q parsed %s index %q could not be cast to an integer",
1279: 					ifName,
1280: 					indexKey,
1281: 					index,
1282: 				)
1283: 			}
1284: 			if parsedIndices[indexKey] < 1 {
1285: 				return "", fmt.Errorf(
1286: 					"%q parsed %q index %q does not match requirement >= 1",
1287: 					ifName,
1288: 					indexKey,
1289: 					index,
1290: 				)
1291: 			}
1292: 		} else {
1293: 			foundIndices[indexKey] = false
1294: 		}
1295: 	}
1296: 
1297: 	// Card, MDA and port are present
1298: 	if foundIndices["card"] && foundIndices["mda"] && foundIndices["port"] {
1299: 		switch {
1300: 		case foundIndices["xiom"] && foundIndices["connector"]:
1301: 			// XIOM and connector are present, format will be: e1-x2-3-c4-5 -> card 1, xiom 2, mda
1302: 			// 3, connector 4, port 5
1303: 			return fmt.Sprintf(
1304: 				"e%d-x%d-%d-c%d-%d",
1305: 				parsedIndices["card"],
1306: 				parsedIndices["xiom"],
1307: 				parsedIndices["mda"],
1308: 				parsedIndices["connector"],
1309: 				parsedIndices["port"],
1310: 			), nil
1311: 
1312: 		case foundIndices["xiom"]:
1313: 			// Only XIOM present, format will be: e1-x2-3-4 -> card 1, xiom 2, mda 3, port 4
1314: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-x%d-%d-%d", parsedIndices["card"],
1315: 				parsedIndices["xiom"], parsedIndices["mda"], parsedIndices["port"]), nil
1316: 		case foundIndices["connector"]:
1317: 			// Only connector present, format will be: e1-2-c3-4 -> card 1, mda 2, connector 3, port
1318: 			// 4
1319: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d-c%d-%d", parsedIndices["card"],
1320: 				parsedIndices["mda"], parsedIndices["connector"], parsedIndices["port"]), nil
1321: 		default:
1322: 			// No XIOM or connector present, format will be: e1-2-3 -> card 1, mda 2, port 3
1323: 			return fmt.Sprintf("e%d-%d-%d", parsedIndices["card"],
1324: 				parsedIndices["mda"], parsedIndices["port"]), nil
1325: 		}
1326: 	} else {
1327: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%q missing card, mda or port index", ifName)
1328: 	}
1329: }
1330: 
1331: // CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file correct.
1332: func (n *sros) CheckInterfaceName() error {
1333: 	nm := n.Cfg.NetworkMode
1334: 
1335: 	err := n.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
1336: 	if err != nil {
1337: 		return err
1338: 	}
1339: 
1340: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
1341: 		if !MappedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(e.GetIfaceName()) {
1342: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1343: 				"nokia SR OS interface name %q doesn't match the required pattern: %s",
1344: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1345: 				n.InterfaceHelp,
1346: 			)
1347: 		}
1348: 
1349: 		if e.GetIfaceName() == "eth0" && nm != "none" {
1350: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1351: 				"eth0 interface name is not allowed for %s node when network mode is not set to none",
1352: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
1353: 			)
1354: 		}
1355: 	}
1356: 
1357: 	return nil
1358: }

1360: func (n *sros) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {
1361: 	fqdn := ""
1362: 	switch {
1363: 	case n.isStandaloneNode():
1364: 		// check if it is a cpm node. return without error if not
1365: 		if !n.isCPM("") {
1366: 			return nil, nil
1367: 		}
1368: 		// if it is a standalone node use the fqdn
1369: 		fqdn = n.Cfg.Fqdn
1370: 	case n.isDistributedBaseNode():
1371: 		// if it is the
1372: 		cmpNode, err := n.cpmNode()
1373: 		if err != nil {
1374: 			return nil, err
1375: 		}
1376: 		// delegate to cpm node
1377: 		return cmpNode.SaveConfig(ctx)
1378: 	case n.isDistributedCardNode():
1379: 		// check if it is a cpm node. return without error if not
1380: 		if !n.isCPM("") {
1381: 			return nil, nil
1382: 		}
1383: 		fqdn = n.Cfg.LongName
1384: 	}
1385: 
1386: 	if err := n.saveConfigWithAddr(ctx, fqdn); err != nil {
1387: 		return nil, err
1388: 	}
1389: 
1390: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(
1391: 		n.Cfg.LabDir,
1392: 		n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot],
1393: 		configCf3,
1394: 		startupCfgName,
1395: 	)
1396: 
1397: 	return &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{
1398: 		ConfigPath: cfgPath,
1399: 	}, nil
1400: }
1401: 
1402: // saveConfigWithAddr will use the addr string to try to save the config of the node.
1403: func (n *sros) saveConfigWithAddr(ctx context.Context, addr string) error {
1404: 	if n.isConfigClassic() {
1405: 		cmd := []string{"/admin save", "/bof persist on", "/bof save"}
1406: 		return n.srosSendCommandsSSH(ctx, scrapliPlatformNameClassic, cmd)
1407: 	}
1408: 	err := clabnetconf.SaveRunningConfig(fmt.Sprintf("[%s]", addr),
1409: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Username,
1410: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Password,
1411: 		scrapliPlatformName,
1412: 	)
1413: 	if err != nil {
1414: 		return err
1415: 	}
1416: 
1417: 	log.Info(
1418: 		"Saved running configuration",
1419: 		"node",
1420: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
1421: 		"addr",
1422: 		addr,
1423: 		"config-mode",
1424: 		n.kindSpecificCfg().ConfigMode,
1425: 	)
1426: 
1427: 	return nil
1428: }

1430: // TLS bootstrap via NETCONF to enable secure gRPC.
1431: func (n *sros) tlsCertBootstrap(ctx context.Context, addr string) error {
1432: 	// Always import PKI key and cert:
1433: 	// 	 import "cf3:\node.key" in PEM format as "cf3:\system-pki\node.key" (encrypted DER)
1434: 	//   import "cf3:\node.crt" in PEM format as "cf3:\system-pki\node.crt" (encrypted DER)
1435: 	operations := []clabnetconf.Operation{
1436: 		func(d *netconf.Driver) (*response.NetconfResponse, error) {
1437: 			return d.RPC(opoptions.WithFilter(buildPKIImportXML(
1438: 				fmt.Sprintf("cf3:/%s", tlsKeyFile), tlsKeyFile, "key")))
1439: 		},
1440: 		func(d *netconf.Driver) (*response.NetconfResponse, error) {
1441: 			return d.RPC(opoptions.WithFilter(buildPKIImportXML(
1442: 				fmt.Sprintf("cf3:/%s", tlsCertFile), tlsCertFile, "certificate")))
1443: 		},
1444: 	}
1445: 
1446: 	// Activate cert-profile in MD is via NETCONF, in Classic mode is via SSH
1447: 	//  enable enables cert-profile "clab-grpc-certs" administratively
1448: 	cmd := []string{}
1449: 	if n.isConfigClassic() {
1450: 		cmd = append(
1451: 			cmd,
1452: 			fmt.Sprintf(
1453: 				"/configure system security tls cert-profile %s no shutdown",
1454: 				tlsCertProfileName,
1455: 			),
1456: 		)
1457: 	} else {
1458: 		operations = append(operations,
1459: 			func(d *netconf.Driver) (*response.NetconfResponse, error) {
1460: 				return d.EditConfig("candidate", buildTLSProfileXML())
1461: 			},
1462: 			func(d *netconf.Driver) (*response.NetconfResponse, error) {
1463: 				return d.Commit()
1464: 			},
1465: 		)
1466: 	}
1467: 
1468: 	err := clabnetconf.MultiExec(
1469: 		fmt.Sprintf("[%s]", addr),
1470: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Username,
1471: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Password,
1472: 		operations,
1473: 	)
1474: 	if len(cmd) > 0 && n.isConfigClassic() {
1475: 		err := n.srosSendCommandsSSH(ctx, scrapliPlatformNameClassic, cmd)
1476: 		if err != nil {
1477: 			return err
1478: 		}
1479: 	}
1480: 	return err
1481: }

1483: func (n *sros) IsHealthy(_ context.Context) (bool, error) {
1484: 	if !n.isCPM("") {
1485: 		return true, fmt.Errorf("node %q is not a CPM, healthcheck has no effect", n.Cfg.LongName)
1486: 	}
1487: 	// non-partial user startup config might not have any netconf config
1488: 	// so we shouldn't check for this.
1489: 	if isFullConfigFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig) {
1490: 		log.Debug(
1491: 			"node has full startup config, skipping NETCONF check",
1492: 			"kind",
1493: 			n.Cfg.Kind,
1494: 			"node",
1495: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
1496: 		)
1497: 		return true, nil
1498: 	}
1499: 	addr, err := n.MgmtIPAddr()
1500: 	if err != nil {
1501: 		return false, err
1502: 	}
1503: 	log.Debug(
1504: 		"Checking netconf connection",
1505: 		"node",
1506: 		n.Cfg.LongName,
1507: 		"addr",
1508: 		fmt.Sprintf("%q:830", addr),
1509: 	)
1510: 	return CheckPortWithRetry(addr, 830, readyTimeout, int(readyTimeout/retryTimer), retryTimer)
1511: }

1513: // CheckPortWithRetry checks if a port is open with retry logic.
1514: func CheckPortWithRetry(
1515: 	host string,
1516: 	port int,
1517: 	timeout time.Duration,
1518: 	maxRetries int,
1519: 	retryDelay time.Duration,
1520: ) (bool, error) {
1521: 	var lastErr error
1522: 	address := net.JoinHostPort(host, fmt.Sprintf("%d", port))
1523: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
1524: 
1525: 	for i := range maxRetries {
1526: 		if i > 0 {
1527: 			if remaining := time.Until(deadline); remaining <= 0 {
1528: 				break
1529: 			} else if retryDelay < remaining {
1530: 				time.Sleep(retryDelay)
1531: 			} else {
1532: 				time.Sleep(remaining)
1533: 			}
1534: 		}
1535: 
1536: 		remaining := time.Until(deadline)
1537: 		if remaining <= 0 {
1538: 			break
1539: 		}
1540: 
1541: 		dialTimeout := tcpDialTimeout
1542: 		if remaining < dialTimeout {
1543: 			dialTimeout = remaining
1544: 		}
1545: 
1546: 		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", address, dialTimeout)
1547: 		if err == nil {
1548: 			conn.Close()
1549: 			return true, nil
1550: 		}
1551: 		lastErr = err
1552: 	}
1553: 
1554: 	if lastErr == nil {
1555: 		lastErr = fmt.Errorf("timed out checking tcp port %s", address)
1556: 	}
1557: 
1558: 	return false, lastErr
1559: }

1561: // MgmtIP represents the management IPv4/v6 addresses of a node.
1562: type MgmtIP struct {
1563: 	IPv4        string
1564: 	IPv4pLen    int
1565: 	IPv4Gw      string
1566: 	IPv6        string
1567: 	IPv6pLen    int
1568: 	IPv6Gw      string
1569: 	ContainerID string

1572: // distNodeMgmtIPs returns both ipv4 and ipv6 management IP address of a
1573: // distributed node defined via components.
1574: // It returns an error if neither is set in the node config.
1575: func (n *sros) distNodeMgmtIPs() (MgmtIP, error) {
1576: 	ips := MgmtIP{}
1577: 
1578: 	var containerName string
1579: 	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() {
1580: 		if n.netnsNode != nil {
1581: 			containerName = n.netnsNode.Config().LongName
1582: 		}
1583: 	} else {
1584: 		containerName = n.rootCtrName
1585: 	}
1586: 
1587: 	if containerName == "" {
1588: 		return ips, nil
1589: 	}
1590: 
1591: 	containers, err := n.Runtime.ListContainers(
1592: 		context.Background(),
1593: 		[]*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
1594: 			{
1595: 				FilterType: "name",
1596: 				Match:      containerName,
1597: 			},
1598: 		},
1599: 	)
1600: 	if err != nil {
1601: 		return MgmtIP{}, fmt.Errorf("unable to get container %q: %v", containerName, err)
1602: 	}
1603: 
1604: 	for _, container := range containers {
1605: 		if container.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != "" {
1606: 			ips.IPv4 = container.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr
1607: 			ips.IPv4pLen = container.NetworkSettings.IPv4pLen
1608: 			ips.IPv4Gw = container.NetworkSettings.IPv4Gw
1609: 			ips.ContainerID = container.ID
1610: 		}
1611: 		if container.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr != "" {
1612: 			ips.IPv6 = container.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr
1613: 			ips.IPv6pLen = container.NetworkSettings.IPv6pLen
1614: 			ips.IPv6Gw = container.NetworkSettings.IPv6Gw
1615: 			ips.ContainerID = container.ID
1616: 		}
1617: 	}
1618: 
1619: 	return ips, nil
1620: }

1622: // custom override for hosts file entry to write basename when using component nodes.
1623: func (n *sros) GetHostsEntries(ctx context.Context) (clabtypes.HostEntries, error) {
1624: 	result, err := n.DefaultNode.GetHostsEntries(ctx)
1625: 	if err != nil {
1626: 		return nil, err
1627: 	}
1628: 
1629: 	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() {
1630: 		ips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()
1631: 		if err != nil {
1632: 			return clabtypes.HostEntries{}, err
1633: 		}
1634: 
1635: 		if ips.IPv4 != "" { // v4
1636: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
1637: 				ips.IPv4,
1638: 				n.Cfg.LongName,
1639: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV4,
1640: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", n.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(ips.ContainerID))
1641: 		}
1642: 
1643: 		if ips.IPv6 != "" {
1644: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
1645: 				ips.IPv6,
1646: 				n.Cfg.LongName,
1647: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV6,
1648: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", n.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(ips.ContainerID))
1649: 		}
1650: 	}
1651: 
1652: 	return result, nil
1653: }

1655: // MgmtIPAddr returns ipv4 or ipv6 management IP address of the node.
1656: // It returns an error if neither is set in the node config.
1657: func (n *sros) MgmtIPAddr() (string, error) {
1658: 	switch {
1659: 	case n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address != "":
1660: 		return n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address, nil
1661: 	case n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address != "":
1662: 		return n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, nil
1663: 	}
1664: 
1665: 	if !n.isStandaloneNode() {
1666: 		ips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()
1667: 		if err != nil {
1668: 			return "", err
1669: 		}
1670: 
1671: 		switch {
1672: 		case ips.IPv6 != "":
1673: 			return ips.IPv6, nil
1674: 		case ips.IPv4 != "":
1675: 			return ips.IPv4, nil
1676: 		}
1677: 	}
1678: 
1679: 	return n.Cfg.LongName, fmt.Errorf(
1680: 		"no management IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) configured for node %q",
1681: 		n.Cfg.LongName,
1682: 	)
1683: }

1685: // override to fetch CPM to avoid renaming the base node to CPM A.
1686: func (n *sros) GetContainerName() string {
1687: 	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() && n.cpmContainerName != "" {
1688: 		return n.cpmContainerName
1689: 	}
1690: 	return n.DefaultNode.GetContainerName()
1691: }

vars, nil\n391: }\n392: \n393: // Pre Deploy func for SR-SIM kind.\n394: func (n *sros) PreDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PreDeployParams) error {\n395: \tlog.Debug(\"Running context.Context) error {\n462: \tif n.Runtime.Mgmt().Driver == clabtypes.MgmtDriverMacvlan {\n463: \t\treturn nil\n464: \t}\n465: \t// Disable TX checksum offload on the host NS veth for the mgmt interface.\n466: \tvar peerIfIndex int\n467: \terr := n.ExecFunction(ctx, clabutils.VethPeerIndex(\"eth0\", &peerIfIndex))\n468: \tif err != nil {\n469: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Failed to get veth peer index for SR-SIM mgmt interface\",\n470: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName,\n471: \t\t\t\"error\", err)\n472: \t\treturn nil\n473: \t}\n474: \n475: \tif err := clabutils.DisableTxOffloadByIndex(peerIfIndex); err != nil {\n476: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Failed to disable TX checksum offload on SR-SIM mgmt host veth\",\n477: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName,\n478: \t\t\t\"error\", err)\n479: \t}\n480: \n481: \treturn nil\n482: }\n483: \n484: // Post Deploy func for SR-SIM kind.\n485: func (n *sros) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {\n486: \tlog.Info(\"Running postdeploy actions\",\n487: \t\t\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind,\n488: \t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n489: \n490: \t// start waiting for container ready (PID based check)\n491: \tif err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {\n492: \t\treturn err\n493: \t}\n494: \n495: \terrChan := make(chan error, 1)\n496: \n497: \tlogs, err := n.Runtime.StreamLogs(ctx, n.GetContainerName())\n498: \tif err != nil {\n499: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Failed to get container log stream\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"err\", err)\n500: \t} else {\n501: \t\t// Start monitoring in a goroutine\n502: \t\tmonitoringCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)\n503: \t\tdefer cancel()\n504: \t\tdefer logs.Close()\n505: \n506: \t\tgo n.MonitorLogs(monitoringCtx, logs, errChan)\n507: \t}\n508: \n509: \t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n510: \tif err = n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n511: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Unable to populate hosts list\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"err\", err)\n512: \t}\n513: \n514: \tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n515: \tif err != nil {\n516: \t\treturn err\n517: \t}\n518: \tif !n.isCPM(slotAName) {\n519: \t\treturn nil\n520: \t}\n521: \n522: \tif err := n.RequireMgmtReachable(); err != nil {\n523: \t\treturn err\n524: \t}\n525: \n526: \t// Execute SaveConfig after boot. This code should only run on active CPM\n527: \tdeadline := time.Now().Add(readyTimeout)\n528: \tvar lastHealthErr error\n529: \tfor time.Now().Before(deadline) {\n530: \t\t// Check if context is canceled\n531: \t\tif err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {\n532: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"context canceled: %w\", err)\n533: \t\t}\n534: \n535: \t\tisHealthy, err := n.IsHealthy(ctx)\n536: \t\tif err != nil {\n537: \t\t\tlastHealthErr = err\n538: \t\t\tlog.Debug(\n539: \t\t\t\tfmt.Errorf(\n540: \t\t\t\t\t\"health check failed, check 'docker logs -f %s': %w\",\n541: \t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName,\n542: \t\t\t\t\terr,\n543: \t\t\t\t),\n544: \t\t\t)\n545: \t\t}\n546: \n547: \t\tif isHealthy {\n548: \t\t\taddr, err := n.MgmtIPAddr()\n549: \t\t\tif err != nil {\n550: \t\t\t\treturn err\n551: \t\t\t}\n552: \t\t\t// TLS bootstrap in case of n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue flag\n553: \t\t\tif *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {\n554: \t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\"TLS cert/key bootstrap for node %q\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n555: \n556: \t\t\t\terr = n.tlsCertBootstrap(ctx, addr)\n557: \t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n558: \t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n559: \t\t\t\t\t\t\"TLS cert/key bootstrap to node %q failed: %w\",\n560: \t\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName,\n561: \t\t\t\t\t\terr,\n562: \t\t\t\t\t)\n563: \t\t\t\t}\n564: \t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\n565: \t\t\t\t\t\"Completed bootstrap for gRPC-TLS profile on node %s\",\n566: \t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n567: \t\t\t\t)\n568: \t\t\t}\n569: \n570: \t\t\t// Partial or NO Config Provided\n571: \t\t\tif !isFullConfigFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig) {\n572: \t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\"Saving node %q config as startup...\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n573: \t\t\t\terr = n.saveConfigWithAddr(ctx, addr)\n574: \t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n575: \t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"save config to node %q, failed: %w\", n.Cfg.LongName, err)\n576: \t\t\t\t}\n577: \t\t\t}\n578: \t\t\treturn nil\n579: \t\t}\n580: \n581: \t\t// Wait before next check\n582: \t\tselect {\n583: \t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n584: \t\t\treturn ctx.Err()\n585: \t\tcase err := <-errChan:\n586: \t\t\tlog.With(\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind, \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName).Debugf(\"got %q on errChan\", err)\n587: \t\t\tlog.Info(\"Skipping postdeploy actions\", \"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind, \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n588: \t\t\treturn nil\n589: \t\tcase <-time.After(retryTimer):\n590: \t\t\t// continue to next iteration\n591: \t\t}\n592: \t}\n593: \n594: \tif lastHealthErr != nil {\n595: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q did not become healthy before timeout: %w\",\n596: \t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName, lastHealthErr)\n597: \t}\n598: \n599: \treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q did not become healthy before timeout\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n600: }\n601: \n602: // Delete func for SR-SIM kind.\n603: func (n *sros) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n604: \t// if not distributed, follow default node implementation\n605: \tif n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {\n606: \t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)\n607: \t}\n608: \n609: \tvar errs []error\n610: \n611: \t// Delete all the component containers\n612: \tfor _, componentNode := range n.componentNodes {\n613: \t\terr := componentNode.Delete(ctx)\n614: \t\tif err != nil {\n615: \t\t\tlog.Warn(err)\n616: \t\t\terrs = append(errs, err)\n617: \t\t}\n618: \t}\n619: \n620: \terrs = append(errs, n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))\n621: \n622: \treturn errors.Join(errs...)\n623: }\n624: \n625: func (n *sros) setupComponentNodes() error {\n626: \tif !n.isDistributedBaseNode() {\n627: \t\treturn nil\n628: \t}\n629: \n630: \tn.netnsNode = new(namespaceNode)\n631: \tif err := n.netnsNode.Init(\n632: \t\tn.newNetnsConfig(),\n633: \t\tclabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()),\n634: \t); err != nil {\n635: \t\treturn err\n636: \t}\n637: \trootCtrName := n.netnsNode.Config().LongName\n638: \n639: \t// loop through the components, creating them\n640: \tfor _, c := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n641: \t\t// instantiate a new nokia_srsim instance\n642: \t\tsrosNode := new(sros)\n643: \t\tcomponentNode := clabnodes.Node(srosNode)\n644: \n645: \t\t// copy the original node's NodeConfig to the component\n646: \t\tcomponentConfig, err := deep.Copy(n.Cfg)\n647: \t\tif err != nil {\n648: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to deep copy node config for component: %w\", err)\n649: \t\t}\n650: \n651: \t\t// component nodes join to the nents pause container\n652: \t\tcomponentConfig.NetworkMode = fmt.Sprintf(\"container:%s\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName())\n653: \n654: \t\t// adjust the config values from the original node\n655: \t\tcomponentConfig.ShortName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.ShortName, c.Slot)\n656: \t\tcomponentConfig.LongName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.LongName, c.Slot)\n657: \t\tcomponentConfig.NodeType = n.Cfg.NodeType\n658: \t\tkindSpecificConfig.Of(componentConfig).Components = nil\n659: \t\tcomponentConfig.Fqdn = n.calcComponentFqdn(c.Slot)\n660: \t\tcomponentConfig.DNS = nil\n661: \t\tcomponentConfig.PortBindings = nil\n662: \t\tcomponentConfig.PortSet = nil\n663: \n664: \t\t// Component fields fill env keys the user did not set. Node env wins.\n665: \t\tif componentConfig.Env == nil {\n666: \t\t\tcomponentConfig.Env = map[string]string{}\n667: \t\t}\n668: \t\tkeepUserEnv(n.Cfg.ShortName, componentConfig.Env, componentDerivedEnv(c), n.userEnv)\n669: \t\t// Slot identifies this container. A node-level NOKIA_SROS_SLOT cannot apply to every card.\n670: \t\tcomponentConfig.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot] = c.Slot\n671: \n672: \t\t// adjust label based env vars\n673: \t\tcomponentConfig.Env[\"CLAB_LABEL_\"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.NodeName)] = componentConfig.ShortName\n674: \t\tcomponentConfig.Env[\"CLAB_LABEL_\"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.LongName)] = componentConfig.LongName\n675: \n676: \t\tif componentConfig.Labels == nil {\n677: \t\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels = map[string]string{}\n678: \t\t}\n679: \n680: \t\t// adjust labels\n681: \t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = componentConfig.ShortName\n682: \t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.LongName] = componentConfig.LongName\n683: \t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName\n684: \t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName\n685: \n686: \t\t// Preserve the topology env. Init must not snapshot the merged component env,\n687: \t\t// or config generation would treat component flags as user overrides.\n688: \t\tsrosNode.userEnv = maps.Clone(n.userEnv)\n689: \n690: \t\t// init the component\n691: \t\terr = componentNode.Init(componentConfig)\n692: \t\tif err != nil {\n693: \t\t\treturn err\n694: \t\t}\n695: \t\t// set the runtime by copying it from the general node\n696: \t\tcomponentNode.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime())\n697: \n698: \t\t// store root components for cpms, for config gen\n699: \t\tsrosNode.rootComponents = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components\n700: \t\t// store base node name\n701: \t\tsrosNode.baseShortName = n.Cfg.ShortName\n702: \t\tsrosNode.baseLongName = n.Cfg.LongName\n703: \t\tsrosNode.rootCtrName = rootCtrName\n704: \n705: \t\t// store the node in the componentNodes\n706: \t\tn.componentNodes = append(n.componentNodes, componentNode)\n707: \t}\n708: \treturn nil\n709: }\n710: \n711: // deployFabric deploys the distributed SR-SIM when the `components` key is present.\n712: func (n *sros) deployFabric(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n713: \tnetnsConfig := n.netnsNode.Config()\n714: \n715: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address\n716: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto\n717: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength\n718: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway\n719: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address\n720: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto\n721: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength\n722: \tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway\n723: \n724: \tif err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams); err != nil {\n725: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"deploy network namespace node %q: %w\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)\n726: \t}\n727: \n728: \tips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()\n729: \tif err != nil {\n730: \t\treturn err\n731: \t}\n732: \n733: \tn.setComponentMgmtEnv(ips)\n734: \n735: \t// loop through the components, creating them\n736: \tfor _, c := range n.componentNodes {\n737: \t\tif err := c.PreDeploy(ctx, n.preDeployParams); err != nil {\n738: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"pre-deploy for component node %q: %w\", c.GetShortName(), err)\n739: \t\t}\n740: \t\t// deploy the component\n741: \t\terr := c.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)\n742: \t\tif err != nil {\n743: \t\t\treturn err\n744: \t\t}\n745: \t}\n746: \n747: \tcpmSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()\n748: \tif err != nil {\n749: \t\treturn err\n750: \t}\n751: \t// store the CPM container name\n752: \tn.cpmContainerName = n.calcComponentName(n.Cfg.LongName, cpmSlot)\n753: \tn.renameDone = true\n754: \n755: \t// adjust also the mgmt IP addresses of the general node\n756: \tn.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = ips.IPv4\n757: \tn.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = ips.IPv6\n758: \n759: \treturn nil\n760: }\n761: \n762: // set env vars for the CPMs so that they are aware of mgmt info.\n763: func (n *sros) setComponentMgmtEnv(ips MgmtIP) {\n764: \tfor _, component := range n.componentNodes {\n765: \t\tcfg := component.Config()\n766: \t\tslot := strings.ToUpper(cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot])\n767: \n768: \t\tif slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName {\n769: \t\t\tcontinue\n770: \t\t}\n771: \n772: \t\tenv := cfg.Env\n773: \t\tif intf := env[\"NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF\"]; intf != \"\" && intf != \"eth0\" {\n774: \t\t\tcontinue\n775: \t\t}\n776: \t\tif env[envSrosIPv4Active] != \"\" || env[envSrosIPv6Active] != \"\" {\n777: \t\t\tcontinue\n778: \t\t}\n779: \n780: \t\t// SKIP if the user defines this env var\n781: \t\texplicitRoutes := false\n782: \t\tfor key := range env {\n783: \t\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(key, envSrosStaticRoutePrefix) {\n784: \t\t\t\texplicitRoutes = true\n785: \t\t\t\tbreak\n786: \t\t\t}\n787: \t\t}\n788: \t\tif explicitRoutes {\n789: \t\t\tcontinue\n790: \t\t}\n791: \n792: \t\tif ips.IPv4 != \"\" {\n793: \t\t\tenv[envSrosIPv4Active] = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%d\", ips.IPv4, ips.IPv4pLen)\n794: \t\t\tif ips.IPv4Gw != \"\" {\n795: \t\t\t\tenv[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+\"1\"] = \"0.0.0.0/0@\" + ips.IPv4Gw\n796: \t\t\t}\n797: \t\t}\n798: \n799: \t\tif ips.IPv6 != \"\" {\n800: \t\t\tenv[envSrosIPv6Active] = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%d\", ips.IPv6, ips.IPv6pLen)\n801: \t\t\tif ips.IPv6Gw != \"\" {\n802: \t\t\t\tenv[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+\"2\"] = \"::/0@\" + ips.IPv6Gw\n803: \t\t\t}\n804: \t\t}\n805: \t}\n806: }\n807: \n808: // isDistributedCard checks if the slot variable is set, hence it is an instance (slot) of a\n809: // distributed setup.\n810: // isDistributedCardNode returns true if this node is a card (linecard/IOM)\n811: // in a distributed SR-SIM deployment. A distributed card has a slot assignment\n812: // but no components of its own.\n813: func (n *sros) isDistributedCardNode() bool {\n814: \t_, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]\n815: \treturn exists && len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) == 0\n816: }\n817: \n818: // isDistributedBaseNode returns true if this is the base node of a distributed\n819: // SR-SIM deployment. isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents(n.Cfg.NodeType, n.kindSpecificCfg().Components)\n823: \t}\n824: \treturn len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1\n825: }\n826: \n827: // isStandaloneNode returns true if this is a standalone (non-distributed) SR-SIM node.\n828: func (n *sros) isStandaloneNode() bool {\n829: \treturn !n.isDistributedBaseNode() && !n.isDistributedCardNode()\n830: }\n831: \n832: // calcComponentName appends the line card suffix to the given node name.\n833: func (n *sros) calcComponentName(name, slot string) string {\n834: \tif n.renameDone {\n835: \t\treturn name\n836: \t}\n837: \treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%s\", name, strings.ToLower(slot))\n838: }\n839: \n840: // calcComponentFqdn computes the FQDN for a given slot.\n841: func (n *sros) calcComponentFqdn(slot string) string {\n842: \tif n.renameDone {\n843: \t\treturn n.Cfg.Fqdn\n844: \t}\n845: \tfqdnDotIndex := strings.Index(n.Cfg.Fqdn, \".\")\n846: \tif fqdnDotIndex < 0 {\n847: \t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%s\", n.Cfg.Fqdn, strings.ToLower(slot))\n848: \t}\n849: \tresult := fmt.Sprintf(\n850: \t\t\"%s-%s%s\",\n851: \t\tn.Cfg.Fqdn[:fqdnDotIndex],\n852: \t\tstrings.ToLower(slot),\n853: \t\tn.Cfg.Fqdn[fqdnDotIndex:],\n854: \t)\n855: \treturn result\n856: }\n857: \n858: // cpmNode returns a CPM Node (used in Distributed mode).\n859: func (n *sros) cpmNode() (clabnodes.Node, error) {\n860: \tdefaultSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()\n861: \tif err != nil {\n862: \t\treturn nil, err\n863: \t}\n864: \tdefaultSlot = strings.ToLower(defaultSlot)\n865: \tfor _, cn := range n.componentNodes {\n866: \t\tif cn.GetShortName()[len(cn.GetShortName())-1:] == defaultSlot {\n867: \t\t\treturn cn, nil\n868: \t\t}\n869: \t}\n870: \treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"node %s: node for slot %s not found\", n.GetShortName(), defaultSlot)\n871: }\n872: \n873: // cpmSlot returns the Slot of the preferred CPM Node (used when Distributed mode).\n874: // It prefers slot A if present, otherwise returns slot Slots are accepted in either case.\n877: \tfor _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n878: \t\tif strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotAName) {\n879: \t\t\treturn slotAName, nil\n880: \t\t}\n881: \t}\n882: \tfor _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n883: \t\tif strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotBName) {\n884: \t\t\treturn slotBName, nil\n885: \t\t}\n886: \t}\n887: \treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"node %s: unable to determine default slot\", n.GetShortName())\n888: }\n889: \n890: // Deploy deploys the SR-SIM kind.\n891: func (n *sros) Deploy(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n892: \t// if it is a chassis with multiple cards (i.e. components)\n893: \tif n.isDistributedBaseNode() {\n894: \t\terr := n.deployFabric(ctx, deployParams)\n895: \t\tif err != nil {\n896: \t\t\treturn err\n897: \t\t}\n898: \n899: \t\t// Update the nodes state\n900: \t\tn.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)\n901: \t\treturn nil\n902: \t}\n903: \n904: \t// if it is a regular node\n905: \terr := n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)\n906: \tif err != nil {\n907: \t\treturn err\n908: \t}\n909: \n910: \treturn nil\n911: }\n912: \n913: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n914: // commands\n915: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\n916: func (n *sros) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n917: \tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n918: \tdefer cancel()\n919: \tvar err error\n920: \treadyCmds := []string{readyCmdCpm, readyCmdBoth, readyCmdIom}\n921: \treadyCmdsStrings := []string{\"CPM\", \"BOTH\", \"IOM\"}\n922: \tlog.Debug(\"Waiting for SR OS node to boot...\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n923: \tfor {\n924: \t\tselect {\n925: \t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n926: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n927: \t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR OS node %s to boot: %v\",\n928: \t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n929: \t\t\t\terr,\n930: \t\t\t)\n931: \t\tdefault:\n932: \t\t\t// check if cpm is running\n933: \t\t\tfor k, cmd := range readyCmds {\n934: \t\t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(cmd)\n935: \t\t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n936: \t\t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n937: \t\t\t\t\tlogMsg := fmt.Sprintf(\n938: \t\t\t\t\t\t\"status check %s failed on %s retrying\",\n939: \t\t\t\t\t\treadyCmdsStrings[k],\n940: \t\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n941: \t\t\t\t\t)\n942: \t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n943: \t\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n944: \t\t\t\t\t}\n945: \t\t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n946: \t\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\n947: \t\t\t\t\t\t\t\", output:%s\",\n948: \t\t\t\t\t\t\tstrings.ReplaceAll(execResult.String(), \"\\n\", \"; \"),\n949: \t\t\t\t\t\t)\n950: \t\t\t\t\t}\n951: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n952: \t\t\t\t}\n953: \t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() == 0 {\n954: \t\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(\"SR OS is ready to be configured\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n955: \t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n956: \t\t\t\t}\n957: \t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n958: \t\t\t}\n959: \t\t}\n960: \t}\n961: }\n962: \n963: // checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\n964: func (*sros) checkKernelVersion() error {\n965: \t// retrieve running kernel version\n966: \tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n967: \tif err != nil {\n968: \t\treturn err\n969: \t}\n970: \n971: \t// do the comparison\n972: \tif !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {\n973: \t\tlog.Warnf(\n974: \t\t\t\"Nokia SR OS requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s. Not all features might function properly!\",\n975: \t\t\trequiredKernelVersion,\n976: \t\t\tkv,\n977: \t\t)\n978: \t}\n979: \treturn nil\n980: }\n981: \n982: func (n *sros) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {\n983: \t// perform the sros specific kernel version check\n984: \terr := n.checkKernelVersion()\n985: \tif err != nil {\n986: \t\treturn err\n987: \t}\n988: \n989: \t// check the sros component slot config for validaity\n990: \terr = n.checkComponentSlotsConfig()\n991: \tif err != nil {\n992: \t\treturn err\n993: \t}\n994: \n995: \treturn n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)\n996: }\n997: \n998: // Func that creates the Dirs used for the kind SR-SIM and sets/merges the default Env vars.\n999: func (n *sros) createSROSFiles(ctx context.Context) error {\n1000: \tlog.Debug(\"Creating directory structure for SR OS container\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n1001: \n1002: \tvar err error\n1003: \n1004: \tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" && (n.isCPM(\"\") || n.isStandaloneNode()) {\n1005: \t\t// copy license file to node specific directory in lab\n1006: \t\tlicPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\")\n1007: \t\tif err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), n.Cfg.License, licPath,\n1008: \t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n1009: \t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n1010: \t\t\t\t\"license copying src %s -> dst %s failed: %v\",\n1011: \t\t\t\tn.Cfg.License,\n1012: \t\t\t\tlicPath,\n1013: \t\t\t\terr,\n1014: \t\t\t)\n1015: \t\t}\n1016: \t\tlog.Debug(\"SR OS license copied\", \"src\", n.Cfg.License, \"dst\", licPath)\n1017: \t}\n1018: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]),\n1019: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1020: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], \"config\"),\n1021: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1022: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf1),\n1023: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1024: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf2),\n1025: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1026: \tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3),\n1027: \t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1028: \tif err := n.writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx); err != nil {\n1029: \t\tlog.Debug(\"Didn't write chassis_info.json to lab dir. Docker version is likely too new.\",\n1030: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", n.Cfg.LabDir, \"error\", err)\n1031: \t}\n1032: \tif n.isCPM(slotAName) || n.isStandaloneNode() {\n1033: \t\terr = n.createSROSCertificates()\n1034: \t}\n1035: \tif err != nil {\n1036: \t\treturn err\n1037: \t}\n1038: \t// Skip config if node is not CPM\n1039: \tif n.isCPM(\"\") || n.isStandaloneNode() {\n1040: \t\terr = n.createSROSConfigFiles()\n1041: \t\tif err != nil {\n1042: \t\t\treturn err\n1043: \t\t}\n1044: \t}\n1045: \treturn nil\n1046: }\n1047: \n1048: // writeChassisInfoToLabDir fetches /opt/nokia/chassis_info.json from the node image\n1049: // (via graph driver, same as srosVersionFromImage) and writes it under n.Cfg.LabDir\n1050: // with the same filename (chassis_info.json).\n1051: func (n *sros) writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx context.Context) error {\n1052: \timageInspect, err := n.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, n.Cfg.Image)\n1053: \tif err != nil {\n1054: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"inspect image: %w\", err)\n1055: \t}\n1056: \tcontent, err := ReadFileFromImageInspect(imageInspect, DefaultChassisInfoPath)\n1057: \tif err != nil {\n1058: \t\treturn err\n1059: \t}\n1060: \tdstPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, filepath.Base(DefaultChassisInfoPath))\n1061: \tlicensed := append([]byte(chassisInfoFileLicense), content...)\n1062: \tif err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, licensed, clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n1063: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"write %s: %w\", dstPath, err)\n1064: \t}\n1065: \tlog.Debug(\"Wrote chassis_info.json to lab dir\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", dstPath)\n1066: \tn.warnUnsupportedComponents(content)\n1067: \treturn nil\n1068: }\n1069: \n1070: // warnUnsupportedComponents validates the effective component configuration against the\n1071: // chassis_info.json extracted from this exact image. Validation is advisory and never blocks\n1072: // deploy.\n1073: func (n *sros) warnUnsupportedComponents(content []byte) {\n1074: \t// A distributed node validates once, from CPM A, to avoid duplicate warnings from CPM B.\n1075: \tif !n.isStandaloneNode() && !n.isCPM(slotAName) {\n1076: \t\treturn\n1077: \t}\n1078: \n1079: \tinfo, err := parseChassisInfo(content)\n1080: \tif err != nil {\n1081: \t\tlog.Warn(\"Could not validate SR-SIM components against chassis_info.json\",\n1082: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"error\", err)\n1083: \t\treturn\n1084: \t}\n1085: \n1086: \tcomponents := n.rootComponents\n1087: \tif len(components) == 0 {\n1088: \t\tcomponents = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components\n1089: \t}\n1090: \n1091: \teffective := n.componentsForConfig(components)\n1092: \tif len(effective) == 0 {\n1093: \t\t// Environment variables can configure integrated hardware without a components entry.\n1094: \t\teffective = []*Component{n.componentForConfig(nil)}\n1095: \t}\n1096: \n1097: \tnodeType := n.Cfg.NodeType\n1098: \tif chassis := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosChassis]); chassis != \"\" {\n1099: \t\tnodeType = chassis\n1100: \t}\n1101: \tfor _, warning := range info.componentWarnings(nodeType, n.componentSFM(), effective) {\n1102: \t\tlog.Warn(\"SR-SIM component configuration may not be supported\",\n1103: \t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName,\n1104: \t\t\t\"chassis\", nodeType,\n1105: \t\t\t\"warning\", warning)\n1106: \t}\n1107: }\n1108: \n1109: // Func that Places the Certificates in the right place and format.\n1110: func (n *sros) createSROSCertificates() error {\n1111: \tif *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {\n1112: \t\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3),\n1113: \t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n1114: \t\tkeyPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3, tlsKeyFile)\n1115: \t\tif err := clabutils.CreateFile(keyPath, n.Config().TLSKey); err != nil {\n1116: \t\t\treturn err\n1117: \t\t}\n1118: \n1119: \t\tcertPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3, tlsCertFile)\n1120: \t\terr := clabutils.CreateFile(certPath, n.Config().TLSCert)\n1121: \t\tif err != nil {\n1122: \t\t\treturn err\n1123: \t\t}\n1124: \t}\n1125: \treturn nil\n1126: }\n1127: \n1128: // SlotIsInteger checks if the slot string represents a valid integer.\n1129: func SlotIsInteger(s string) bool {\n1130: \t_, err := strconv.Atoi(s)\n1131: \treturn err == nil\n1132: }\n1133: \n1134: // Check if a container is a CPM.\n1135: // isCPM checks if a container is a CPM (Control Processing Module).\n1136: // Returns false if the slot is a linecard (integer slot).\n1137: // If a specific CPM name is provided, returns false if this is a different CPM.\n1138: func (n *sros) isCPM(cpm string) bool {\n1139: \tslot, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]\n1140: \tif !exists {\n1141: \t\t// No slot specified - this is a CPM\n1142: \t\treturn true\n1143: \t}\n1144: \n1145: \t// If slot is an integer, it's a linecard, not a CPM\n1146: \tif SlotIsInteger(slot) {\n1147: \t\treturn false\n1148: \t}\n1149: \n1150: \t// Slot is non-integer (CPM slot). If a specific CPM was requested,\n1151: \t// check if this is that CPM\n1152: \tif cpm != \"\" && !strings.EqualFold(slot, cpm) {\n1153: \t\treturn false\n1154: \t}\n1155: \n1156: \treturn true\n1157: }\n1158: \n1159: func (n *sros) GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n1160: \t// if not a distributed setup call regular GetContainers\n1161: \tif
