goroutine\n\t\tmonitoringCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)\n\t\tdefer cancel()\n\t\tdefer logs.Close()\n\n\t\tgo n.MonitorLogs(monitoringCtx, logs, errChan)\n\t}\n\n\t// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface\n\tif err = n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Unable to populate hosts list\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"err\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tn.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif !n.isCPM(slotAName) {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.RequireMgmtReachable(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// Execute SaveConfig after boot. This code should only run on active CPM\n\tdeadline := time.Now().Add(readyTimeout)\n\tvar lastHealthErr error\n\tfor time.Now().Before(deadline) {\n\t\t// Check if context is canceled\n\t\tif err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"context canceled: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tisHealthy, err := n.IsHealthy(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlastHealthErr = err\n\t\t\tlog.Debug(\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"health check failed, check 'docker logs -f %s': %w\",\n\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName,\n\t\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t\t),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif isHealthy {\n\t\t\taddr, err := n.MgmtIPAddr()\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// TLS bootstrap in case of n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue flag\n\t\t\tif *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\"TLS cert/key bootstrap for node %q\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n\n\t\t\t\terr = n.tlsCertBootstrap(ctx, addr)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"TLS cert/key bootstrap to node %q failed: %w\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName,\n\t\t\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"Completed bootstrap for gRPC-TLS profile on node %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Partial or NO Config Provided\n\t\t\tif !isFullConfigFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig) {\n\t\t\t\tlog.Infof(\"Saving node %q config as startup...\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n\t\t\t\terr = n.saveConfigWithAddr(ctx, addr)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"save config to node %q, failed: %w\", n.Cfg.LongName, err)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Wait before next check\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn ctx.Err()\n\t\tcase err := <-errChan:\n\t\t\tlog.With(\"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind, \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName).Debugf(\"got %q on errChan\", err)\n\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Skipping postdeploy actions\", \"kind\", n.Cfg.Kind, \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tcase <-time.After(retryTimer):\n\t\t\t// continue to next iteration\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif lastHealthErr != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q did not become healthy before timeout: %w\",\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.LongName, lastHealthErr)\n\t}\n\n\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q did not become healthy before timeout\", n.Cfg.LongName)\n}\n\n// Delete func for SR-SIM kind.\nfunc (n *sros) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {\n\t// if not distributed, follow default node implementation\n\tif n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tvar errs []error\n\n\t// Delete all the component containers\n\tfor _, componentNode := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\terr := componentNode.Delete(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Warn(err)\n\t\t\terrs = append(errs, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\terrs = append(errs, n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))\n\n\treturn errors.Join(errs...)\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) setupComponentNodes() error {\n\tif !n.isDistributedBaseNode() {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tn.netnsNode = new(namespaceNode)\n\tif err := n.netnsNode.Init(\n\t\tn.newNetnsConfig(),\n\t\tclabnodes.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime()),\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\trootCtrName := n.netnsNode.Config().LongName\n\n\t// loop through the components, creating them\n\tfor _, c := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n\t\t// instantiate a new nokia_srsim instance\n\t\tsrosNode := new(sros)\n\t\tcomponentNode := clabnodes.Node(srosNode)\n\n\t\t// copy the original node's NodeConfig to the component\n\t\tcomponentConfig, err := deep.Copy(n.Cfg)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to deep copy node config for component: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// component nodes join to the nents pause container\n\t\tcomponentConfig.NetworkMode = fmt.Sprintf(\"container:%s\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName())\n\n\t\t// adjust the config values from the original node\n\t\tcomponentConfig.ShortName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.ShortName, c.Slot)\n\t\tcomponentConfig.LongName = n.calcComponentName(componentConfig.LongName, c.Slot)\n\t\tcomponentConfig.NodeType = n.Cfg.NodeType\n\t\tkindSpecificConfig.Of(componentConfig).Components = nil\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Fqdn = n.calcComponentFqdn(c.Slot)\n\t\tcomponentConfig.DNS = nil\n\t\tcomponentConfig.PortBindings = nil\n\t\tcomponentConfig.PortSet = nil\n\n\t\t// Component fields fill env keys the user did not set. Node env wins.\n\t\tif componentConfig.Env == nil {\n\t\t\tcomponentConfig.Env = map[string]string{}\n\t\t}\n\t\tkeepUserEnv(n.Cfg.ShortName, componentConfig.Env, componentDerivedEnv(c), n.userEnv)\n\t\t// Slot identifies this container. A node-level NOKIA_SROS_SLOT cannot apply to every card.\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot] = c.Slot\n\n\t\t// adjust label based env vars\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Env[\"CLAB_LABEL_\"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.NodeName)] = componentConfig.ShortName\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Env[\"CLAB_LABEL_\"+clabutils.ToEnvKey(clabconstants.LongName)] = componentConfig.LongName\n\n\t\tif componentConfig.Labels == nil {\n\t\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels = map[string]string{}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// adjust labels\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName] = componentConfig.ShortName\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.LongName] = componentConfig.LongName\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName] = n.Cfg.ShortName\n\t\tcomponentConfig.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName] = n.Cfg.LongName\n\n\t\t// Preserve the topology env. Init must not snapshot the merged component env,\n\t\t// or config generation would treat component flags as user overrides.\n\t\tsrosNode.userEnv = maps.Clone(n.userEnv)\n\n\t\t// init the component\n\t\terr = componentNode.Init(componentConfig)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\t// set the runtime by copying it from the general node\n\t\tcomponentNode.WithRuntime(n.GetRuntime())\n\n\t\t// store root components for cpms, for config gen\n\t\tsrosNode.rootComponents = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components\n\t\t// store base node name\n\t\tsrosNode.baseShortName = n.Cfg.ShortName\n\t\tsrosNode.baseLongName = n.Cfg.LongName\n\t\tsrosNode.rootCtrName = rootCtrName\n\n\t\t// store the node in the componentNodes\n\t\tn.componentNodes = append(n.componentNodes, componentNode)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// deployFabric deploys the distributed SR-SIM when the `components` key is present.\nfunc (n *sros) deployFabric(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n\tnetnsConfig := n.netnsNode.Config()\n\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4AddressAuto\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv4Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Address = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6AddressAuto\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength\n\tnetnsConfig.MgmtIPv6Gateway = n.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway\n\n\tif err := n.netnsNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"deploy network namespace node %q: %w\", n.netnsNode.GetShortName(), err)\n\t}\n\n\tips, err := n.distNodeMgmtIPs()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tn.setComponentMgmtEnv(ips)\n\n\t// loop through the components, creating them\n\tfor _, c := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tif err := c.PreDeploy(ctx, n.preDeployParams); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"pre-deploy for component node %q: %w\", c.GetShortName(), err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// deploy the component\n\t\terr := c.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tcpmSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// store the CPM container name\n\tn.cpmContainerName = n.calcComponentName(n.Cfg.LongName, cpmSlot)\n\tn.renameDone = true\n\n\t// adjust also the mgmt IP addresses of the general node\n\tn.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = ips.IPv4\n\tn.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = ips.IPv6\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// set env vars for the CPMs so that they are aware of mgmt info.\nfunc (n *sros) setComponentMgmtEnv(ips MgmtIP) {\n\tfor _, component := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tcfg := component.Config()\n\t\tslot := strings.ToUpper(cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot])\n\n\t\tif slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tenv := cfg.Env\n\t\tif intf := env[\"NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF\"]; intf != \"\" && intf != \"eth0\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif env[envSrosIPv4Active] != \"\" || env[envSrosIPv6Active] != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// SKIP if the user defines this env var\n\t\texplicitRoutes := false\n\t\tfor key := range env {\n\t\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(key, envSrosStaticRoutePrefix) {\n\t\t\t\texplicitRoutes = true\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif explicitRoutes {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ips.IPv4 != \"\" {\n\t\t\tenv[envSrosIPv4Active] = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%d\", ips.IPv4, ips.IPv4pLen)\n\t\t\tif ips.IPv4Gw != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tenv[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+\"1\"] = \"0.0.0.0/0@\" + ips.IPv4Gw\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ips.IPv6 != \"\" {\n\t\t\tenv[envSrosIPv6Active] = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%d\", ips.IPv6, ips.IPv6pLen)\n\t\t\tif ips.IPv6Gw != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tenv[envSrosStaticRoutePrefix+\"2\"] = \"::/0@\" + ips.IPv6Gw\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// isDistributedCard checks if the slot variable is set, hence it is an instance (slot) of a\n// distributed setup.\n// isDistributedCardNode returns true if this node is a card (linecard/IOM)\n// in a distributed SR-SIM deployment. A distributed card has a slot assignment\n// but no components of its own.\nfunc (n *sros) isDistributedCardNode() bool {\n\t_, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]\n\treturn exists && len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) == 0\n}\n\n// isDistributedBaseNode returns true if this is the base node of a distributed\n// SR-SIM deployment. The base node orchestrates multiple component nodes.\nfunc (n *sros) isDistributedBaseNode() bool {\n\tif isIntegratedSrosNodeType(n.Cfg.NodeType) {\n\t\treturn isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents(n.Cfg.NodeType, n.kindSpecificCfg().Components)\n\t}\n\treturn len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) > 1\n}\n\n// isStandaloneNode returns true if this is a standalone (non-distributed) SR-SIM node.\nfunc (n *sros) isStandaloneNode() bool {\n\treturn !n.isDistributedBaseNode() && !n.isDistributedCardNode()\n}\n\n// calcComponentName appends the line card suffix to the given node name.\nfunc (n *sros) calcComponentName(name, slot string) string {\n\tif n.renameDone {\n\t\treturn name\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%s\", name, strings.ToLower(slot))\n}\n\n// calcComponentFqdn computes the FQDN for a given slot.\nfunc (n *sros) calcComponentFqdn(slot string) string {\n\tif n.renameDone {\n\t\treturn n.Cfg.Fqdn\n\t}\n\tfqdnDotIndex := strings.Index(n.Cfg.Fqdn, \".\")\n\tif fqdnDotIndex < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s-%s\", n.Cfg.Fqdn, strings.ToLower(slot))\n\t}\n\tresult := fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\"%s-%s%s\",\n\t\tn.Cfg.Fqdn[:fqdnDotIndex],\n\t\tstrings.ToLower(slot),\n\t\tn.Cfg.Fqdn[fqdnDotIndex:],\n\t)\n\treturn result\n}\n\n// cpmNode returns a CPM Node (used in Distributed mode).\nfunc (n *sros) cpmNode() (clabnodes.Node, error) {\n\tdefaultSlot, err := n.cpmSlot()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefaultSlot = strings.ToLower(defaultSlot)\n\tfor _, cn := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tif cn.GetShortName()[len(cn.GetShortName())-1:] == defaultSlot {\n\t\t\treturn cn, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"node %s: node for slot %s not found\", n.GetShortName(), defaultSlot)\n}\n\n// cpmSlot returns the Slot of the preferred CPM Node (used when Distributed mode).\n// It prefers slot A if present, otherwise returns slot B.\nfunc (n *sros) cpmSlot() (string, error) {\n\t// Prefer slot A, fall back to slot B. Slots are accepted in either case.\n\tfor _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n\t\tif strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotAName) {\n\t\t\treturn slotAName, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, comp := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {\n\t\tif strings.EqualFold(comp.Slot, slotBName) {\n\t\t\treturn slotBName, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"node %s: unable to determine default slot\", n.GetShortName())\n}\n\n// Deploy deploys the SR-SIM kind.\nfunc (n *sros) Deploy(ctx context.Context, deployParams *clabnodes.DeployParams) error {\n\t// if it is a chassis with multiple cards (i.e. components)\n\tif n.isDistributedBaseNode() {\n\t\terr := n.deployFabric(ctx, deployParams)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Update the nodes state\n\t\tn.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t// if it is a regular node\n\terr := n.DefaultNode.Deploy(ctx, deployParams)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config\n// commands\n// returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.\nfunc (n *sros) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\tvar err error\n\treadyCmds := []string{readyCmdCpm, readyCmdBoth, readyCmdIom}\n\treadyCmdsStrings := []string{\"CPM\", \"BOTH\", \"IOM\"}\n\tlog.Debug(\"Waiting for SR OS node to boot...\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\tfor {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"timed out waiting for SR OS node %s to boot: %v\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\t// check if cpm is running\n\t\t\tfor k, cmd := range readyCmds {\n\t\t\t\tcmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(cmd)\n\t\t\t\texecResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg := fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"status check %s failed on %s retrying\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\treadyCmdsStrings[k],\n\t\t\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\" error: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlogMsg += fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\", output:%s\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstrings.ReplaceAll(execResult.String(), \"\\n\", \"; \"),\n\t\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(logMsg)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() == 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Debug(\"SR OS is ready to be configured\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\t\t\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryTimer)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// checkKernelVersion emits a warning if the present kernel version is lower than the required one.\nfunc (*sros) checkKernelVersion() error {\n\t// retrieve running kernel version\n\tkv, err := clabutils.GetKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// do the comparison\n\tif !kv.GreaterOrEqual(requiredKernelVersion) {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\"Nokia SR OS requires a kernel version greater than %s. Detected kernel version: %s. Not all features might function properly!\",\n\t\t\trequiredKernelVersion,\n\t\t\tkv,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx context.Context) error {\n\t// perform the sros specific kernel version check\n\terr := n.checkKernelVersion()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// check the sros component slot config for validaity\n\terr = n.checkComponentSlotsConfig()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn n.DefaultNode.CheckDeploymentConditions(ctx)\n}\n\n// Func that creates the Dirs used for the kind SR-SIM and sets/merges the default Env vars.\nfunc (n *sros) createSROSFiles(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tlog.Debug(\"Creating directory structure for SR OS container\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName)\n\n\tvar err error\n\n\tif n.Cfg.License != \"\" && (n.isCPM(\"\") || n.isStandaloneNode()) {\n\t\t// copy license file to node specific directory in lab\n\t\tlicPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, \"license.key\")\n\t\tif err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), n.Cfg.License, licPath,\n\t\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"license copying src %s -> dst %s failed: %v\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.License,\n\t\t\t\tlicPath,\n\t\t\t\terr,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"SR OS license copied\", \"src\", n.Cfg.License, \"dst\", licPath)\n\t}\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], \"config\"),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf1),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf2),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen)\n\tif err := n.writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Debug(\"Didn't write chassis_info.json to lab dir. Docker version is likely too new.\",\n\t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", n.Cfg.LabDir, \"error\", err)\n\t}\n\tif n.isCPM(slotAName) || n.isStandaloneNode() {\n\t\terr = n.createSROSCertificates()\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// Skip config if node is not CPM\n\tif n.isCPM(\"\") || n.isStandaloneNode() {\n\t\terr = n.createSROSConfigFiles()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// writeChassisInfoToLabDir fetches /opt/nokia/chassis_info.json from the node image\n// (via graph driver, same as srosVersionFromImage) and writes it under n.Cfg.LabDir\n// with the same filename (chassis_info.json).\nfunc (n *sros) writeChassisInfoToLabDir(ctx context.Context) error {\n\timageInspect, err := n.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, n.Cfg.Image)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"inspect image: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tcontent, err := ReadFileFromImageInspect(imageInspect, DefaultChassisInfoPath)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdstPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, filepath.Base(DefaultChassisInfoPath))\n\tlicensed := append([]byte(chassisInfoFileLicense), content...)\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, licensed, clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"write %s: %w\", dstPath, err)\n\t}\n\tlog.Debug(\"Wrote chassis_info.json to lab dir\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", dstPath)\n\tn.warnUnsupportedComponents(content)\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// warnUnsupportedComponents validates the effective component configuration against the\n// chassis_info.json extracted from this exact image. Validation is advisory and never blocks\n// deploy.\nfunc (n *sros) warnUnsupportedComponents(content []byte) {\n\t// A distributed node validates once, from CPM A, to avoid duplicate warnings from CPM B.\n\tif !n.isStandaloneNode() && !n.isCPM(slotAName) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tinfo, err := parseChassisInfo(content)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Could not validate SR-SIM components against chassis_info.json\",\n\t\t\t\"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"error\", err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tcomponents := n.rootComponents\n\tif len(components) == 0 {\n\t\tcomponents = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components\n\t}\n\n\teffective := n.componentsForConfig(components)\n\tif len(effective) == 0 {\n\t\t// Environment variables can configure integrated hardware without a components entry.\n\t\teffective = []*Component{n.componentForConfig(nil)}\n\t}\n\n\tnodeType := n.Cfg.NodeType\n\tif chassis := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosChassis]); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcertPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot], configCf3, tlsCertFile)\n\t\terr := clabutils.CreateFile(certPath, n.Config().TLSCert)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// SlotIsInteger checks if the slot string represents a valid integer.\nfunc SlotIsInteger(s string) bool {\n\t_, err := strconv.Atoi(s)\n\treturn err == nil\n}\n\n// Check if a container is a CPM.\n// isCPM checks if a container is a CPM (Control Processing Module).\n// Returns false if the slot is a linecard (integer slot).\n// If a specific CPM name is provided, returns false if this is a different CPM.\nfunc (n *sros) isCPM(cpm string) bool {\n\tslot, exists := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]\n\tif !exists {\n\t\t// No slot specified - this is a CPM\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\n\t// If slot is an integer, it's a linecard, not a CPM\n\tif SlotIsInteger(slot) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\n\t// Slot is non-integer (CPM slot). nil {\n\t\t\tif ips.IPv4 != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tcnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr = ips.IPv4\n\t\t\t\tcnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv4pLen = ips.IPv4pLen\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif ips.IPv6 != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tcnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr = ips.IPv6\n\t\t\t\tcnts[0].NetworkSettings.IPv6pLen = ips.IPv6pLen\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn cnts, err\n}\n\n// populateHosts adds container = n.cpmContainerName\n\t}\n\n\thosts, err := n.Runtime.GetHostsPath(ctx, containerName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Unable to locate SR OS node /etc/hosts file\", \"node\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"err\", err)\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tvar entriesv4, entriesv6 bytes.Buffer\n\tconst (\n\t\tv4Prefix = \"###### CLAB-v4-START ######\"\n\t\tv4Suffix = \"###### CLAB-v4-END ######\"\n\t\tv6Prefix = \"###### CLAB-v6-START ######\"\n\t\tv6Suffix = \"###### CLAB-v6-END ######\"\n\t)\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, \"\\n%s\\n\", v4Prefix)\n\tfmt.Fprintf(&entriesv6, \"\\n%s\\n\", v6Prefix)\n\tfor node, params := range nodes {\n\t\tif v4 := params.Config().MgmtIPv4Address; v4 != \"\" {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&entriesv4, \"%s\\t%s\\n\", v4, node)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif v6 := params.Config().MgmtIPv6Address; v6 != err\n\t}\n\n\treturn file.Close()\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {\n\tcaptureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(n.InterfaceRegexp, does not match requirement >= 1\",\n\t\t\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\t\t\tindexKey,\n\t\t\t\t\tindex,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tfoundIndices[indexKey] = false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Card, MDA and nil\n\n\t\tcase foundIndices[\"xiom\"]:\n\t\t\t// Only XIOM present, format will be: e1-x2-3-4 -> card 1, xiom 2, mda 3, port 4\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"e%d-x%d-%d-%d\", none\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {\n\tfqdn := \"\"\n\tswitch {\n\tcase n.Cfg.Fqdn\n\tcase n.isDistributedBaseNode():\n\t\t// if it is the\n\t\tcmpNode, err := n.cpmNode()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\t// delegate to cpm node\n\t\treturn n.Cfg.LongName\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.saveConfigWithAddr(ctx, fqdn); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tcfgPath := filepath.Join(\n\t\tn.Cfg.LabDir,\n\t\tn.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot],\n\t\tconfigCf3,\n\t\tstartupCfgName,\n\t)\n\n\treturn &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{\n\t\tConfigPath: cfgPath,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// addr),\n\t\tn.Cfg.Credentials.Username,\n\t\tn.Cfg.Credentials.Password,\n\t\tscrapliPlatformName,\n\t)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\n\t\t\"Saved running configuration\",\n\t\t\"node\",\n\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\"addr\",\n\t\taddr,\n\t\t\"config-mode\",\n\t\tn.kindSpecificCfg().ConfigMode,\n\t)\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// TLS bootstrap via NETCONF to administratively\n\tcmd := []string{}\n\tif n.isConfigClassic() {\n\t\tcmd = append(\n\t\t\tcmd,\n\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\"/configure system security tls cert-profile %s no time.Duration,\n\tmaxRetries int,\n\tretryDelay time.Duration,\n) (bool, error) {\n\tvar lastErr error\n\taddress := net.JoinHostPort(host, fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", port))\n\tdeadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)\n\n\tfor i := range maxRetries {\n\t\tif i > 0 {\n\t\t\tif remaining := time.Until(deadline); remaining <= 0 {\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t} else if retryDelay < remaining {\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(retryDelay)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ttime.Sleep(remaining)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tremaining := time.Until(deadline)\n\t\tif remaining <= 0 {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tdialTimeout := tcpDialTimeout\n\t\tif remaining < dialTimeout {\n\t\t\tdialTimeout = remaining\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconn, err := net.DialTimeout(\"tcp\", address, dialTimeout)\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\tconn.Close()\n\t\t\treturn true, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tlastErr = err\n\t}\n\n\tif lastErr == nil {\n\t\tlastErr = fmt.Errorf(\"timed out checking tcp port %s\", address)\n\t}\n\n\treturn false, lastErr\n}\n\n// MgmtIP represents the management IPv4/v6 addresses of a node.\ntype MgmtIP struct {\n\tIPv4        string\n\tIPv4pLen    int\n\tIPv4Gw hasVrnetlab {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"node %q: kind is nokia_srsim but the image is a vrnetlab image; use kind: nokia_sros with this image, or use the SR-SIM container image for kind: nokia_srsim\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif title, ok := insp.Config.Labels[srosImageTitleLabel]; ok && title == srosImageTitle {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\"node %q: kind is nokia_srsim but the provided image does not have the correct labels; please use a valid SR-SIM container image or run a more recent version of the SR-SIM container image to suppress this warning\",\n\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t)\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) GetContainerStatus(ctx context.Context) clabruntime.ContainerStatus {\n\tif n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tvar (\n\t\thasRunning    bool\n\t\thasPaused     bool\n\t\thasRestarting bool\n\t\thasCreated    bool\n\t\thasStopped    bool\n\t\thasRemoving   bool\n\t)\n\n\tfor _, componentNode := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tswitch componentNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) {\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Running:\n\t\t\thasRunning = true\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Paused:\n\t\t\thasPaused = true\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Restarting:\n\t\t\thasRestarting = true\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Created:\n\t\t\thasCreated = true\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Stopped:\n\t\t\thasStopped = true\n\t\tcase clabruntime.Removing:\n\t\t\thasRemoving = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase hasRunning:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Running\n\tcase hasPaused:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Paused\n\tcase hasRestarting:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Restarting\n\tcase hasCreated:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Created\n\tcase hasStopped:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Stopped\n\tcase hasRemoving:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.Removing\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn clabruntime.NotFound\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) Start(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {\n\t\tif err := n.DefaultNode.Start(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn n.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.ensureNetnsRunning(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, c := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tif _, err := n.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, c.Config().LongName, c); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q component %q start error: %w\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName, c.Config().ShortName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := n.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn n.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx)\n}\n\nfunc (n *sros) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif n.isStandaloneNode() || n.isDistributedCardNode() {\n\t\treturn n.DefaultNode.Stop(ctx)\n\t}\n\n\tif n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.Stopped {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tif err := n.ParkEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, c := range n.componentNodes {\n\t\tif err := n.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, c.Config().LongName, n.StopSignal); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Warnf(\"node %q component %q stop error: %v\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName, c.Config().ShortName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ComputeDiff extends the default diff by ignoring component order and slot case, so that only\n// a change to the set of components marks the kind-specific config as changed.\nfunc (n *sros) ComputeDiff(oldCfg, newCfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig) *clabtypes.TopologyDiff {\n\tdiff := n.DefaultNode.ComputeDiff(oldCfg, newCfg)\n\n\tif oldCfg == nil || newCfg == nil {\n\t\treturn diff\n\t}\n\n\toldKC, oldOK := oldCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(*KindSpecificConfig)\n\tnewKC, newOK := newCfg.KindSpecificConfig.(*KindSpecificConfig)\n\n\tif oldOK && newOK && oldKC.equalIgnoringComponentOrder(newKC) {\n\t\tdiff.Fields = slices.DeleteFunc(\n\t\t\tdiff.Fields,\n\t\t\tfunc(f string) bool { return f == \"KindSpecificConfig\" },\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn diff\n}\n\n// DefaultLinkType returns the default link type for an SR-SIM node\n// when the brief notation of a link definition is used.\n// It returns veth-stitch for SR-SIM nodes to support pcap and netem features,\n// see https://github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/pull/3270.\nfunc (*sros) DefaultLinkType() clablinks.LinkType {\n\treturn clablinks.LinkTypeVethStitch\n}\n\n// RestoreEndpoints retains normal lifecycle parking while restoring the logical\n// node's symlink as well as the component symlinks created by the runtime.\nfunc (n *sros) RestoreEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif err := n.DefaultNode.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif !n.isDistributedBaseNode() {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tnsPath, err := n.GetNSPath(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn clabutils.LinkContainerNS(nsPath, n.Cfg.LongName)\n}",

5: package sros
6: 
7: import (
8: 	"fmt"
9: 	"regexp"
10: )
11: 
12: var (
13: 	sarRegexp   = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\bsar-`)
14: 	sarHmRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(sar-hm|sar-hmc)\b`)
15: 
16: 	ixrRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\bixr-`)
17: )
18: 
19: // ConfigMode is the configuration mode (model-driven or classic).
20: type ConfigMode string
21: 
22: const (
23: 	ConfigModeModelDriven ConfigMode = "model-driven"
24: 	ConfigModeClassic     ConfigMode = "classic"
25: 	ConfigModeMixed       ConfigMode = "mixed"
26: )
27: 
28: // UnmarshalYAML accepts only the known configuration modes.
29: func (m *ConfigMode) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(any) error) error {
30: 	var s string
31: 	if err := unmarshal(&s); err != nil {
32: 		return err
33: 	}
34: 
35: 	switch mode := ConfigMode(s); mode {
36: 	case ConfigModeModelDriven, ConfigModeClassic, ConfigModeMixed:
37: 		*m = mode
38: 
39: 		return nil
40: 	}
41: 
42: 	return fmt.Errorf("invalid config-mode %q, valid values: %s, %s, %s",
43: 		s, ConfigModeModelDriven, ConfigModeClassic, ConfigModeMixed)
44: }
45: 
46: // ConfigFamily is the node family (SR, IXR, SAR).
47: type ConfigFamily string
48: 
49: const (
50: 	ConfigFamilySR  ConfigFamily = "sr"
51: 	ConfigFamilyIXR ConfigFamily = "ixr"
52: 	ConfigFamilySAR ConfigFamily = "sar"
53: )
54: 
55: // ConfigVariant encodes mode, node family, and security for template and snippet selection.
56: // Single source of truth for "what config do we use for this node.".
57: type ConfigVariant struct {
58: 	Mode         ConfigMode   // model-driven, classic, or mixed
59: 	Family       ConfigFamily // sr, ixr, sar
60: 	SecureGrpc   bool
61: 	ForceClassic bool // true when SAR-Hm forces classic (MD disabled)
62: }
63: 
64: // snippetSet holds the system and gRPC config snippets for a variant.
65: // Other snippets (SNMP, logging, netconf, SSH) are shared across variants.
66: type snippetSet struct {
67: 	SystemConfig string
68: 	GRPCConfig   string
69: }
70: 
71: // FullSnippetSet holds all config snippet strings for a variant (system, grpc, snmp, netconf,
72: // logging, ssh).
73: // Single table-driven result for "which snippets apply to this variant.".
74: type FullSnippetSet struct {
75: 	SystemConfig  string
76: 	GRPCConfig    string
77: 	SNMPConfig    string
78: 	NetconfConfig string
79: 	LoggingConfig string
80: 	SSHConfig     string
81: }
82: 
83: // getFullSnippetSet returns the full set of snippet strings for the given variant.
84: // Shared snippets (SNMP, logging, netconf, SSH) are the same for all variants.
85: func getFullSnippetSet(v ConfigVariant) FullSnippetSet {
86: 	s := getSnippetSet(v)
87: 	return FullSnippetSet{
88: 		SystemConfig:  s.SystemConfig,
89: 		GRPCConfig:    s.GRPCConfig,
90: 		SNMPConfig:    snmpv2Config,
91: 		NetconfConfig: netconfConfig,
92: 		LoggingConfig: loggingConfig,
93: 		SSHConfig:     sshConfig,
94: 	}
95: }
96: 
97: // resolveConfigVariant returns the config variant for node n from NodeType,
98: // the config-mode kind-specific config key, and Certificate.Issue. SAR-Hm forces classic mode;
99: // the caller should apply that to tplData and the kind-specific config when ForceClassic is true.
100: func (n *sros) resolveConfigVariant() ConfigVariant {
101: 	mode := n.kindSpecificCfg().ConfigMode
102: 	if mode == "" {
103: 		mode = ConfigModeModelDriven
104: 	}
105: 	secureGrpc := n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue != nil && *n.Cfg.Certificate.Issue
106: 
107: 	var family ConfigFamily
108: 	switch {
109: 	case n.isIXRNode():
110: 		family = ConfigFamilyIXR
111: 	case n.isSARNode():
112: 		family = ConfigFamilySAR
113: 	default:
114: 		family = ConfigFamilySR
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	forceClassic := false
118: 	if family == ConfigFamilySAR && n.isSARHmNode() {
119: 		forceClassic = true
120: 		if mode != ConfigModeClassic && mode != ConfigModeMixed {
121: 			mode = ConfigModeClassic
122: 		}
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	return ConfigVariant{
126: 		Mode:         mode,
127: 		Family:       family,
128: 		SecureGrpc:   secureGrpc,
129: 		ForceClassic: forceClassic,
130: 	}
131: }
132: 
133: // getSnippetSet returns the system and gRPC snippet set for the given variant.
134: func getSnippetSet(v ConfigVariant) snippetSet {
135: 	sys := systemCfg
136: 	grpc := grpcConfig
137: 	if !v.SecureGrpc {
138: 		grpc = grpcConfigInsecure
139: 	}
140: 	switch v.Family {
141: 	case ConfigFamilyIXR:
142: 		sys = systemCfgIXR
143: 		grpc = grpcConfigIXR
144: 		if !v.SecureGrpc {
145: 			grpc = grpcConfigIXRInsecure
146: 		}
147: 	case ConfigFamilySAR:
148: 		sys = systemCfgSAR
149: 		grpc = grpcConfigSAR
150: 		if !v.SecureGrpc {
151: 			grpc = grpcConfigSARInsecure
152: 		}
153: 	}
154: 	return snippetSet{SystemConfig: sys, GRPCConfig: grpc}
155: }
156: 
157: // isIXRNode returns true if this is an IXR node type (case-insensitive).
158: func (n *sros) isIXRNode() bool {
159: 	return ixrRegexp.MatchString(n.Cfg.NodeType)
160: }
161: 
162: // isSARNode returns true if this is a SAR node type (case-insensitive).
163: func (n *sros) isSARNode() bool {
164: 	return sarRegexp.MatchString(n.Cfg.NodeType)
165: }
166: 
167: // isSARHmNode returns true if this is a SAR-Hm or SAR-Hmc node type (case-insensitive).
168: func (n *sros) isSARHmNode() bool {
169: 	return sarHmRegexp.MatchString(n.Cfg.NodeType)
170: }

snippets apply to this variant.\".\ntype FullSnippetSet struct {\n\tSystemConfig  string\n\tGRPCConfig    string\n\tSNMPConfig    string\n\tNetconfConfig string\n\tLoggingConfig string\n\tSSHConfig     string\n}\n\n// getFullSnippetSet returns the full set of snippet strings for the given variant.\n// Shared snippets (SNMP, logging, netconf, SSH) are the same for all variants.\nfunc snmpv2Config,\n\t\tNetconfConfig: netconfConfig,\n\t\tLoggingConfig: loggingConfig,\n\t\tSSHConfig:     sshConfig,\n\t}\n}\n\n// resolveConfigVariant returns the config variant for node n from Reasoning
Note: `isDistributedBaseNode` for integrated node types returns true only when `isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents` — meaning ixr-r6 with components on slot A and B is distributed. But `integratedSrosDefaultComponents["ixr-r6"].allowedSlots` = [A, B]; others only [A]. So redundant integrated chassis only for ixr-r6. Hmm, but sr-1s with components A+B... `isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents` requires all slots allowed; for sr-1s, B is not allowed → false → standalone. But then `setupStandaloneComponents` errors if >1 component. Good.

Wait: for ixr-r6 with components A and B → isDistributedBaseNode true → distributed path. But integrated nodes (ixr-r6) in distributed mode... generateIntegratedComponentConfig on component nodes: rootCtrName != "" (netns container). It uses `n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]` to find matching rootComponents entry. That's for integrated redundant. But the integrated components are CPM slots only (A/B) — buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines uses override.XIOM/MDA but discards override's slot; card slot is "1". OK.

But note: for redundant integrated, each component node (CPM A and CPM B) generates integrated config with the same card config? componentForConfig(n.integratedComponentOverride()) — the override is the component matching this node's slot; each CPM would apply its own component env. Probably fine.

32: func TestCheckPortWithRetry(t *testing.T) {
33: 	seed, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
34: 	require.NoError(t, err)
35: 
36: 	addr := seed.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr)
37: 	port := addr.Port
38: 	require.NoError(t, seed.Close())
39: 
40: 	done := make(chan struct{})
41: 	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
42: 	go func() {
43: 		defer close(done)
44: 
45: 		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
46: 		ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port))
47: 		if err != nil {
48: 			errCh <- err
49: 			return
50: 		}
51: 		defer ln.Close()
52: 
53: 		conn, err := ln.Accept()
54: 		if err != nil {
55: 			errCh <- err
56: 			return
57: 		}
58: 		conn.Close()
59: 	}()
60: 
61: 	ok, err := CheckPortWithRetry("127.0.0.1", port, time.Second, 10, 25*time.Millisecond)
62: 	require.NoError(t, err)
63: 	require.True(t, ok)
64: 
65: 	select {
66: 	case <-done:
67: 		select {
68: 		case err := <-errCh:
69: 			require.NoError(t, err)
70: 		default:
71: 		}
72: 	case <-time.After(time.Second):
73: 		t.Fatal("listener did not accept a connection")
74: 	}
75: }

175: 		cfg, err := n.buildStartupConfig(false) // full config, not partial
176: 		require.NoError(t, err)
177: 		assert.Contains(t, cfg, "system name foo")
178: 	})
179: 
180: 	t.Run("default_and_partial_path", func(t *testing.T) {
181: 		ctrl := gomock.NewController(t)
182: 		mockRt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(ctrl)
183: 		mockRt.EXPECT().Mgmt().Return(&clabtypes.MgmtNet{MTU: 1500}).AnyTimes()
184: 
185: 		issueCert := false
186: 		n := &sros{}
187: 		n.DefaultNode = *clabnodes.NewDefaultNode(n)
188: 		n.Cfg = &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
189: 			ShortName:     "n1",
190: 			LongName:      "lab-n1",
191: 			NodeType:      "sr-1",
192: 			StartupConfig: "",
193: 			Certificate:   &clabtypes.CertificateConfig{Issue: &issueCert},
194: 			TLSKey:        "",
195: 			TLSCert:       "",
196: 			TLSAnchor:     "",
197: 			LabDir:        t.TempDir(),
198: 		}
199: 		kindSpecificConfig.Of(n.Cfg).ConfigMode = ConfigModeModelDriven
200: 		n.WithRuntime(mockRt)
201: 		n.swVersion = &SrosVersion{"0", "0", "0"}
202: 
203: 		cfg, err := n.buildStartupConfig(true) // no full config; use default + partial
204: 		require.NoError(t, err)
205: 		assert.NotEmpty(t, cfg)
206: 		// Default config should include typical SR OS snippets (banner, system, etc.)
207: 		assert.Contains(t, cfg, "Welcome to Nokia SR OS")
208: 	})
209: }

890: func TestComponentMgmtEnv(t *testing.T) {
891: 	dualStack := MgmtIP{
892: 		IPv4: "172.20.20.10", IPv4pLen: 24, IPv4Gw: "172.20.20.1",
893: 		IPv6: "3fff:172:20:20::10", IPv6pLen: 64, IPv6Gw: "3fff:172:20:20::1",
894: 	}
895: 	tests := []struct {
896: 		name string
897: 		ips  MgmtIP
898: 		env  map[string]string
899: 		want map[string]string
900: 	}{
901: 		{
902: 			name: "dual stack runtime allocation", ips: dualStack,
903: 			want: map[string]string{
904: 				envSrosIPv4Active: "172.20.20.10/24", envSrosIPv6Active: "3fff:172:20:20::10/64",
905: 				envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "1": "0.0.0.0/0@172.20.20.1",
906: 				envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "2": "::/0@3fff:172:20:20::1",
907: 			},
908: 		},
909: 		{
910: 			name: "IPv4 without gateway", ips: MgmtIP{IPv4: "192.0.2.10", IPv4pLen: 27},
911: 			want: map[string]string{envSrosIPv4Active: "192.0.2.10/27"},
912: 		},
913: 		{
914: 			name: "IPv6 only",
915: 			ips:  MgmtIP{IPv6: "2001:db8::10", IPv6pLen: 80, IPv6Gw: "2001:db8::1"},
916: 			want: map[string]string{
917: 				envSrosIPv6Active:              "2001:db8::10/80",
918: 				envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "2": "::/0@2001:db8::1",
919: 			},
920: 		},
921: 		{name: "no management addresses"},
922: 		{
923: 			name: "explicit IPv4 opts out of both families", ips: dualStack,
924: 			env:  map[string]string{envSrosIPv4Active: "192.0.2.2/24"},
925: 			want: map[string]string{envSrosIPv4Active: "192.0.2.2/24"},
926: 		},
927: 		{
928: 			name: "explicit IPv6", ips: dualStack,
929: 			env:  map[string]string{envSrosIPv6Active: "2001:db8::2/64"},
930: 			want: map[string]string{envSrosIPv6Active: "2001:db8::2/64"},
931: 		},
932: 		{
933: 			name: "explicit route", ips: dualStack,
934: 			env:  map[string]string{envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "1": "192.0.2.0/24@172.20.20.9"},
935: 			want: map[string]string{envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "1": "192.0.2.0/24@172.20.20.9"},
936: 		},
937: 		{
938: 			name: "empty explicit route still opts out", ips: dualStack,
939: 			env:  map[string]string{envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "CUSTOM": ""},
940: 			want: map[string]string{envSrosStaticRoutePrefix + "CUSTOM": ""},
941: 		},
942: 		{
943: 			name: "custom management interface", ips: dualStack,
944: 			env:  map[string]string{"NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF": "eth9"},
945: 			want: map[string]string{"NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF": "eth9"},
946: 		},
947: 	}
948: 	for _, tt := range tests {
949: 		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
950: 			n := newSrosInitTestNode("sr-14s", []*Component{
951: 				{Slot: slotAName, Env: tt.env}, {Slot: slotBName}, {Slot: "1"},
952: 			})
953: 			require.NoError(t, n.Init(n.Cfg))
954: 			n.setComponentMgmtEnv(tt.ips)
955: 			got := map[string]string{}
956: 			for key, value := range n.componentNodes[0].Config().Env {
957: 				isAddress := key == envSrosIPv4Active || key == envSrosIPv6Active
958: 				isRoute := strings.HasPrefix(key, envSrosStaticRoutePrefix)
959: 				if isAddress || isRoute || key == "NOKIA_SROS_MGMT_IF" {
960: 					got[key] = value
961: 				}
962: 			}
963: 			if tt.want == nil {
964: 				assert.Empty(t, got)
965: 			} else {
966: 				assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
967: 			}
968: 			// A per-CPM override must not suppress automatic configuration for B.
969: 			if tt.ips.IPv4 != "" {
970: 				assert.Equal(t, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", tt.ips.IPv4, tt.ips.IPv4pLen),
971: 					n.componentNodes[1].Config().Env[envSrosIPv4Active])
972: 			}
973: 			assert.NotContains(t, n.componentNodes[2].Config().Env, envSrosIPv4Active)
974: 			assert.NotContains(t, n.componentNodes[2].Config().Env, envSrosIPv6Active)
975: 		})
976: 	}
977: }

94: -For known SR/IXR integrated nodes, containerlab's default model-driven configuration also provisions the default card and MDA configuration. The built-in defaults cover `sr-1`, `sr-1s`, `ixr-r6`, `ixr-e2`, `ixr-e2c`, `ixr-e2n`, `ixr-e2n-s`, `ixr-e3c`, `ixr-e3x` and `ixr-ec`. If the hardware is overridden with `components` or SR-SIM environment variables, the generated SR OS card/MDA configuration follows those overrides.
95: +For known SR and IXR integrated types, containerlab generates model-driven configuration for the default card and MDA(s).
96:  
97: -Integrated nodes accept at most one `components` entry because they still run as a single container. The component slot can be omitted or set to `A`; `ixr-r6` also accepts a single `B` slot override.
98: +The built-in defaults cover `sr-1`, `sr-1s`, `ixr-r6`, `ixr-e2`, `ixr-e2c`, `ixr-e2n`, `ixr-e2n-s`, `ixr-e2sc`, `ixr-e3c`, `ixr-e3x` and `ixr-ec`.
99: +
100: +An integrated node other than `ixr-r6` runs as one container and accepts one `components` entry. The slot can be omitted or set to `A`. `ixr-r6` accepts slots `A` and `B`. Two `ixr-r6` entries, one for `A` and one for `B`, run as a dual-CPIOM node with one container per CPM. Integrated nodes do not accept numeric line-card slots.
101: +
102: +A `components` entry with `type` sets `NOKIA_SROS_CARD`. Containerlab then skips generated card and MDA configuration, because those defaults belong to the built-in card. Set `type` when the integrated card itself must change, for example `cpm-ixr-e2n/imm4-sfp+4-sfp+`.
103: +
104: +Node `env` overrides `components`: `type`, `xiom`, `mda`, per-component `env`, and the `sfm` key. When both set the same variable to different values, the environment variable wins and containerlab logs a warning naming that variable. `NOKIA_SROS_MDA_*` and `NOKIA_SROS_XIOM_*` are written into the generated configuration. `NOKIA_SROS_CARD` skips that generation, the same as a component `type`. On a distributed node, `NOKIA_SROS_SLOT` does not replace each component's slot.
105:

113:  1. Component containers are attached to an internal namespace pause container.
114:  2. When changing a MDA or card type from its default value, the configuration for card, SFM and MDA must be also defined.
115:  3. Links can be added referring to the node name. The same [interface naming](#interface-naming) convention holds for all SR-SIM nodes.
116: -4. Environment variable based configuration on per-component, or node-level will override the configuration set in `type`, `xiom` and `mda` fields.
117: +4. Environment variable based configuration on per-component, or node-level will override the configuration set in `type`, `xiom` and `mda` fields. Node-level `env` wins over both. When the values differ, containerlab logs a warning naming the environment variable that was kept.
118:  
119:  ##### Configuration for components
120:  
121:  When using the `components` structure in the node definition for a distributed node, containerlab will also generate the SR OS configuration for the installed components in the chassis, as well as relevant power supply configuration[^6] to ensure the installed components come up without requiring a user to manually provide the configuration. The same generated configuration mechanism is used for the built-in SR/IXR integrated defaults.
122:  
123: +At deploy time, containerlab reads `chassis_info.json` from the selected SR-SIM image and compares the effective `components` configuration with the hardware types listed for that chassis. Unsupported card slots and card, SFM, XIOM, or MDA types produce warnings but do not stop deployment. This is a best-effort check: compatibility that is not represented in `chassis_info.json`, such as the MDA types supported by a specific XIOM, is not validated.
124: +
125:  /// details | Disabling generated SR OS configuration for `components`
126:      type: tip
127:  You can disable this config generation behavior by setting the `gen-component-config: false` [kind-specific config key](../nodes.md#kind-specific-config) on the node, or on the base node for a distributed chassis.

144: +
145: +### Chassis info and component checks
146: +
147: +During PreDeploy, `createSROSFiles` reads `/opt/nokia/chassis_info.json` from the node image and writes it to `n.Cfg.LabDir/chassis_info.json`, prefixed with the license header. Failure to read the file is logged and does not stop deployment.
148: +
149: +The same file is then compared with the effective component configuration. Aliases such as `SAR-Mx` to `SAR-Hx` are followed. Unsupported slots, CPM/IOM types, SFM, XIOM, direct MDAs, and fixed-hardware mismatches produce warnings only. MDAs nested under an XIOM are not checked, because the file does not say which MDA types a given XIOM accepts.
150: +
151: +### Environment precedence
152: +
153: +Node `env` overrides per-component `env`, which overrides `type`, `xiom`, `mda`, and `sfm`. When a node environment variable replaces a different component value, containerlab logs that the component value will not be used and names the variable. `NOKIA_SROS_SLOT` still comes from each component in a distributed node, because one node-level slot cannot identify every card.

322: +import (

326: +	"strconv"
327: +	"strings"

329: +
330:  // DefaultChassisInfoPath is the path to chassis_info.json inside SROS/SR SIM container images.
331:  const DefaultChassisInfoPath = "/opt/nokia/chassis_info.json"
332:

334:  const chassisInfoFileLicense = "// Copyright 2026 Nokia\n// Licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License.\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause\n\n"
335: +
336: +type chassisInfoEntry struct {
337: +	Alias      string            `json:"alias"`
338: +	CPM        []string          `json:"cpm"`
339: +	IOM        []string          `json:"iom"`
340: +	IOMSlots   int               `json:"iom_slots"`
341: +	MDA        []*string         `json:"mda"`
342: +	FixedMDAs  map[string]string `json:"fixed_mdas"`
343: +	SFM        []string          `json:"sfm"`
344: +	XIOM       []string          `json:"xiom"`
345: +	FixedHWCfg string            `json:"fixed_hw_cfg"`
346: +	Integrated bool              `json:"integrated"`
347: +	Redundant  bool              `json:"redundant"`
348: +}
349: +
350: +type chassisInfo map[string]chassisInfoEntry
351: +
352: +func parseChassisInfo(content []byte) (chassisInfo, error) {
353: +	var info chassisInfo
354: +	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &info); err != nil {
355: +		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse chassis_info.json: %w", err)
356: +	}
357: +	return info, nil
358: +}
359: +
360: +func (i chassisInfo) entry(nodeType string) (chassisInfoEntry, bool) {
361: +	key := ""
362: +	for candidate := range i {
363: +		if strings.EqualFold(candidate, strings.TrimSpace(nodeType)) {
364: +			key = candidate
365: +			break
366: +		}
367: +	}
368: +	if key == "" {
369: +		return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
370: +	}
371: +
372: +	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
373: +	for {
374: +		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
375: +			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
376: +		}
377: +		seen[key] = struct{}{}
378: +
379: +		entry := i[key]
380: +		if entry.Alias == "" {
381: +			return entry, true
382: +		}
383: +
384: +		key = ""
385: +		for candidate := range i {
386: +			if strings.EqualFold(candidate, entry.Alias) {
387: +				key = candidate
388: +				break
389: +			}
390: +		}
391: +		if key == "" {
392: +			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
393: +		}
394: +	}
395: +}
396: +
397: +// componentWarnings returns best-effort validation warnings. It deliberately skips checks
398: +// that chassis_info.json cannot express, such as which MDA types belong under a specific XIOM.
399: +func (i chassisInfo) componentWarnings(nodeType, sfm string, components []*Component) []string {
400: +	entry, ok := i.entry(nodeType)
401: +	if !ok {
402: +		return []string{
403: +			fmt.Sprintf(
404: +				"chassis type %q is not present in chassis_info.json; component compatibility was not checked",
405: +				nodeType,
406: +			),
407: +		}
408: +	}
409: +
410: +	var warnings []string
411: +	if sfm != "" && len(entry.SFM) > 0 && !slices.Contains(entry.SFM, sfm) {
412: +		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
413: +			"SFM type %q is not listed for chassis type %q",
414: +			sfm,
415: +			nodeType,
416: +		))
417: +	}
418: +
419: +	for _, component := range components {
420: +		if component == nil {
421: +			continue
422: +		}
423: +		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))
424: +		if slot == "" {
425: +			slot = slotAName
426: +		}
427: +
428: +		switch {
429: +		case slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName:
430: +			if slot == slotBName && !entry.Redundant {
431: +				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
432: +					"component slot %s is not listed as supported for chassis type %q",
433: +					slot,
434: +					nodeType,
435: +				))
436: +			}
437: +			if component.Type != "" &&
438: +				entry.FixedHWCfg != "" &&
439: +				component.Type != entry.FixedHWCfg {
440: +				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
441: +					"component type %q in slot %s does not match fixed hardware %q for chassis type %q",
442: +					component.Type,
443: +					slot,
444: +					entry.FixedHWCfg,
445: +					nodeType,
446: +				))
447: +			} else if component.Type != "" &&
448: +				entry.FixedHWCfg == "" &&
449: +				len(entry.CPM) > 0 &&
450: +				!slices.Contains(entry.CPM, component.Type) {
451: +				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
452: +					"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
453: +					component.Type,
454: +					slot,
455: +					nodeType,
456: +				))
457: +			}
458: +		default:
459: +			numericSlot, err := strconv.Atoi(slot)
460: +			if err == nil {
461: +				if entry.IOMSlots > 0 && numericSlot > entry.IOMSlots {
462: +					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
463: +						"component slot %s exceeds the %d IOM slots listed for chassis type %q",
464: +						slot,
465: +						entry.IOMSlots,
466: +						nodeType,
467: +					))
468: +				}
469: +				if component.Type != "" &&
470: +					len(entry.IOM) > 0 &&
471: +					!slices.Contains(entry.IOM, component.Type) {
472: +					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
473: +						"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
474: +						component.Type,
475: +						slot,
476: +						nodeType,
477: +					))
478: +				}
479: +			}
480: +		}
481: +
482: +		for _, xiom := range component.XIOM {
483: +			if xiom.Type != "" &&
484: +				len(entry.XIOM) > 0 &&
485: +				!slices.Contains(entry.XIOM, xiom.Type) {
486: +				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
487: +					"XIOM type %q in component slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
488: +					xiom.Type,
489: +					slot,
490: +					nodeType,
491: +				))
492: +			}
493: +		}
494: +
495: +		if entry.Integrated || (slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName) {
496: +			warnings = append(warnings, validateMDAs(nodeType, entry, component.MDA)...)
497: +		}
498: +	}
499: +
500: +	return warnings
501: +}
502: +
503: +func validateMDAs(nodeType string, entry chassisInfoEntry, mdas MDAS) []string {
504: +	var warnings []string
505: +	for _, mda := range mdas {
506: +		if fixed, exists := entry.FixedMDAs[strconv.Itoa(mda.Slot)]; exists {
507: +			if mda.Type != fixed {
508: +				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
509: +					"MDA type %q in slot %d does not match fixed MDA %q for chassis type %q",
510: +					mda.Type,
511: +					mda.Slot,
512: +					fixed,
513: +					nodeType,
514: +				))
515: +			}
516: +			continue
517: +		}
518: +		if mda.Type != "" && !containsChassisType(entry.MDA, mda.Type) {
519: +			warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
520: +				"MDA type %q in slot %d is not listed for chassis type %q",
521: +				mda.Type,
522: +				mda.Slot,
523: +				nodeType,
524: +			))
525: +		}
526: +	}
527: +	return warnings
528: +}
529: +
530: +func containsChassisType(types []*string, value string) bool {
531: +	for _, typ := range types {
532: +		if typ != nil && *typ == value {
533: +			return true
534: +		}
535: +	}
536: +	return false
537: +}

691: +func (n *sros) checkComponentSlotsConfig() error {
692: +	// check Slots are unique

694: +	for _, component := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {

709: +	}

713: +// componentDerivedEnv is the environment a component would set from its type, XIOM, MDA,
714: +// and per-component env. Per-component env overrides the typed fields.
715: +func componentDerivedEnv(c *Component) map[string]string {
716: +	derived := map[string]string{}
717: +	if c == nil {
718: +		return derived
719: +	}
720: +	setComponentEnvVars(derived, c)
721: +	maps.Copy(derived, c.Env)
722: +	return derived
723: +}
724: +
725: +// warnUserEnvOverrides logs when a node env var replaces a component-derived value.
726: +func warnUserEnvOverrides(node string, derived, userEnv map[string]string) {
727: +	for key, componentValue := range derived {
728: +		envValue, userSet := userEnv[key]
729: +		if !userSet || componentValue == envValue {
730: +			continue
731: +		}
732: +		log.Warn(
733: +			fmt.Sprintf(
734: +				"component value %q will not be used because environment variable %s is set",
735: +				componentValue,
736: +				key,
737: +			),
738: +			"node", node,
739: +			"env", key,
740: +			"component-value", componentValue,
741: +			"env-value", envValue,
742: +		)
743: +	}
744: +}
745: +
746: +// keepUserEnv copies component-derived keys into dst unless the user already set that key.
747: +// A user value wins, and a differing component value is logged.
748: +func keepUserEnv(node string, dst, derived, userEnv map[string]string) {
749: +	warnUserEnvOverrides(node, derived, userEnv)
750: +	for key, componentValue := range derived {
751: +		if envValue, userSet := userEnv[key]; userSet {
752: +			dst[key] = envValue
753: +			continue
754: +		}
755: +		dst[key] = componentValue
756: +	}
757: +}
758: +
759: +// cloneComponent returns a deep copy of c suitable for env overrides during config generation.
760: +func cloneComponent(c *Component) *Component {
761: +	if c == nil {
762: +		return &Component{}
763: +	}
764: +	out := *c
765: +	out.Env = maps.Clone(c.Env)
766: +	out.MDA = slices.Clone(c.MDA)
767: +	if len(c.XIOM) > 0 {
768: +		out.XIOM = make(XIOMS, len(c.XIOM))
769: +		for i, xiom := range c.XIOM {
770: +			xiom.MDA = slices.Clone(xiom.MDA)
771: +			out.XIOM[i] = xiom
772: +		}
773: +	}
774: +	return &out
775: +}
776: +
777: +// applyHardwareEnv overlays SR-SIM card, XIOM, and MDA environment variables onto c.
778: +// NOKIA_SROS_SLOT is left unchanged; it identifies the container rather than provisioned hardware.
779: +func applyHardwareEnv(c *Component, env map[string]string) {
780: +	if c == nil || len(env) == 0 {
781: +		return
782: +	}
783: +	if card := env[envNokiaSrosCard]; card != "" {
784: +		c.Type = card
785: +	}
786: +	for key, val := range env {
787: +		if val == "" {
788: +			continue
789: +		}
790: +		switch {
791: +		case strings.HasPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_X"):
792: +			rest := strings.TrimPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_X")
793: +			xiomStr, mdaStr, ok := strings.Cut(rest, "_")
794: +			if !ok {
795: +				continue
796: +			}
797: +			xiomSlot, errX := strconv.Atoi(xiomStr)
798: +			mdaSlot, errM := strconv.Atoi(mdaStr)
799: +			if errX != nil || errM != nil || xiomSlot <= 0 || mdaSlot <= 0 {
800: +				continue
801: +			}
802: +			upsertXiomMDA(c, xiomSlot, mdaSlot, val)
803: +		case strings.HasPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_"):
804: +			slot, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_"))
805: +			if err != nil || slot <= 0 {
806: +				continue
807: +			}
808: +			c.MDA = upsertMDA(c.MDA, slot, val)
809: +		case strings.HasPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosXIOM+"_X"):
810: +			slot, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosXIOM+"_X"))
811: +			if err != nil || slot <= 0 {
812: +				continue
813: +			}
814: +			upsertXiomType(c, slot, val)
815: +		}
816: +	}
817: +}
818: +
819: +func upsertMDA(mdas MDAS, slot int, typ string) MDAS {
820: +	for i := range mdas {
821: +		if mdas[i].Slot == slot {
822: +			mdas[i].Type = typ
823: +			return mdas
824: +		}
825: +	}
826: +	return append(mdas, MDA{Slot: slot, Type: typ})
827: +}
828: +
829: +func upsertXiomType(c *Component, slot int, typ string) {
830: +	for i := range c.XIOM {
831: +		if c.XIOM[i].Slot == slot {
832: +			c.XIOM[i].Type = typ
833: +			return
834: +		}
835: +	}
836: +	c.XIOM = append(c.XIOM, XIOM{Slot: slot, Type: typ})
837: +}
838: +
839: +func upsertXiomMDA(c *Component, xiomSlot, mdaSlot int, typ string) {
840: +	for i := range c.XIOM {
841: +		if c.XIOM[i].Slot != xiomSlot {
842: +			continue
843: +		}
844: +		c.XIOM[i].MDA = upsertMDA(c.XIOM[i].MDA, mdaSlot, typ)
845: +		return
846: +	}
847: +	c.XIOM = append(c.XIOM, XIOM{
848: +		Slot: xiomSlot,
849: +		MDA:  MDAS{{Slot: mdaSlot, Type: typ}},
850: +	})
851: +}

1424: +			}
1425: +
1426: +			defer r.Close() // skipcq: GO-S2307
1427: +
1428: +			_, err = io.Copy(b, r)
1429: +			if err != nil {
1430: +				return err
1431: +			}
1432: +

1434: +			if err != nil {
1435: +				return err
1436: +			}
1437: +			if configContent.Len() == 0 {
1438: +				log.Warn(
1439: +					"Buffer empty, PARTIAL config template parsing error",
1440: +					"node",
1441: +					n.Cfg.ShortName,
1442: +				)
1443: +			} else {

1445: +					n.Cfg.ShortName, "partial-config", configContent.String())

1447: +			}

1451: +				"node",

1454: +		}
1455: +	}

1457: +}

1459: +// isConfigClassic reports whether the node is in classic or mixed configuration mode.
1460: +func (n *sros) isConfigClassic() bool {
1461: +	mode := n.kindSpecificCfg().ConfigMode
1462: +	return mode == ConfigModeClassic || mode == ConfigModeMixed
1463: +}
1464: +
1465: +// isFullConfigFile returns true if the config file doesn't contain .partial substring
1466: +// and the config file is NOT nil (ie. startup config IS defined).
1467: +// it is intended that the 'c' arg is n.Cfg.StartupConfig.
1468: +func isFullConfigFile(c string) bool {
1469: +	return c != "" && !clabutils.IsPartialConfigFile(c)
1470: +}

1542: +		return n.DefaultNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
1543: +	} else if n.isDistributedCardNode() {

1545: +	}

1549: +// DeleteNetnsSymlink deletes the symlink file created for the container netns.
1550: +func (n *sros) DeleteNetnsSymlink() error {
1551: +	var errs []error
1552: +
1553: +	// if it is the base node, then we need to delete the symlink for all the components.
1554: +	if n.isDistributedBaseNode() {
1555: +		for _, componentNode := range n.componentNodes {
1556: +			errs = append(errs, componentNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
1557: +		}
1558: +		if n.netnsNode != nil {
1559: +			errs = append(errs, n.netnsNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink())
1560: +		}
1561: +		errs = append(errs, clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(n.Cfg.LongName))
1562: +	}
1563: +
1564: +	errs = append(errs, n.DefaultNode.DeleteNetnsSymlink(), n.cleanupParkingNetNS())
1565: +
1566: +	return errors.Join(errs...)
1567: +}

2004: +// warnUnsupportedComponents validates the effective component configuration against the
2005: +// chassis_info.json extracted from this exact image. Validation is advisory and never blocks
2006: +// deploy.
2007: +func (n *sros) warnUnsupportedComponents(content []byte) {
2008: +	// A distributed node validates once, from CPM A, to avoid duplicate warnings from CPM B.
2009: +	if !n.isStandaloneNode() && !n.isCPM(slotAName) {
2010: +		return
2011: +	}
2012: +
2013: +	info, err := parseChassisInfo(content)
2014: +	if err != nil {
2015: +		log.Warn("Could not validate SR-SIM components against chassis_info.json",
2016: +			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "error", err)
2017: +		return
2018: +	}
2019: +
2020: +	components := n.rootComponents
2021: +	if len(components) == 0 {
2022: +		components = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components
2023: +	}
2024: +
2025: +	effective := n.componentsForConfig(components)
2026: +	if len(effective) == 0 {
2027: +		// Environment variables can configure integrated hardware without a components entry.
2028: +		effective = []*Component{n.componentForConfig(nil)}
2029: +	}
2030: +
2031: +	nodeType := n.Cfg.NodeType
2032: +	if chassis := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosChassis]); chassis != "" {
2033: +		nodeType = chassis
2034: +	}
2035: +	for _, warning := range info.componentWarnings(nodeType, n.componentSFM(), effective) {
2036: +		log.Warn("SR-SIM component configuration may not be supported",
2037: +			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName,
2038: +			"chassis", nodeType,
2039: +			"warning", warning)
2040: +	}
2041: +}

2910:  // srosTemplateData holds all data needed for template selection and execution.

2922: +// getTemplateForVariant returns the template string and name for the given config variant.
2923: +// swVersion is for future SR OS 26+ template selection (e.g. cfgTplSROS26 when Major >= "26").
2924: +func getTemplateForVariant(v ConfigVariant, swVersion *SrosVersion) (tmpl string, tplName string) {
2925: +	// Model-driven (or mixed treated as classic below when family is classic)
2926: +	if v.Mode == ConfigModeModelDriven {
2927: +		// Placeholder for version-specific template: if swVersion != nil && swVersion.Major >= "26"
2928: +		// { return cfgTplSROS26, "clab-sros-config-sros26" }
2929: +		return cfgTplSROS25, "clab-sros-config-sros25"
2930: +	}
2931: +	// Classic (or mixed)
2932: +	tmpl = cfgTplClassic
2933: +	tplName = "clab-sros-config-classic"
2934: +	switch v.Family {
2935: +	case ConfigFamilyIXR:
2936: +		return cfgTplClassicIxr, "clab-sros-config-classic-ixr"
2937: +	case ConfigFamilySAR:
2938: +		return cfgTplClassicSar, "clab-sros-config-classic-sar"
2939: +	default:
2940: +		return tmpl, tplName
2941: +	}
2942: +}
2943: +
2944: +// selectConfigTemplate chooses the config template from the config variant (mode + family).
2945: +func (n *sros) selectConfigTemplate(tplData *srosTemplateData) (*template.Template, error) {
2946: +	v := n.resolveConfigVariant()
2947: +	tmpl, tplName := getTemplateForVariant(v, tplData.SwVersion)
2948: +	return template.New(tplName).
2949: +		Funcs(clabutils.CreateFuncs()).
2950: +		Parse(tmpl)
2951: +}

2906: +	//go:embed configs/sar/sar_config_classic.go.tpl

2910:  // srosTemplateData holds all data needed for template selection and execution.
2911:  type srosTemplateData struct {

2915: @@ -43,5 +64,36 @@ type tplIFace struct {

2921: +
2922: +// getTemplateForVariant returns the template string and name for the given config variant.
2923: +// swVersion is for future SR OS 26+ template selection (e.g. cfgTplSROS26 when Major >= "26").
2924: +func getTemplateForVariant(v ConfigVariant, swVersion *SrosVersion) (tmpl string, tplName string) {
2925: +	// Model-driven (or mixed treated as classic below when family is classic)
2926: +	if v.Mode == ConfigModeModelDriven {
2927: +		// Placeholder for version-specific template: if swVersion != nil && swVersion.Major >= "26"
2928: +		// { return cfgTplSROS26, "clab-sros-config-sros26" }
2929: +		return cfgTplSROS25, "clab-sros-config-sros25"
2930: +	}
2931: +	// Classic (or mixed)
2932: +	tmpl = cfgTplClassic
2933: +	tplName = "clab-sros-config-classic"
2934: +	switch v.Family {
2935: +	case ConfigFamilyIXR:
2936: +		return cfgTplClassicIxr, "clab-sros-config-classic-ixr"
2937: +	case ConfigFamilySAR:
2938: +		return cfgTplClassicSar, "clab-sros-config-classic-sar"
2939: +	default:
2940: +		return tmpl, tplName
2941: +	}
2942: +}
2943: +
2944: +// selectConfigTemplate chooses the config template from the config variant (mode + family).
2945: +func (n *sros) selectConfigTemplate(tplData *srosTemplateData) (*template.Template, error) {
2946: +	v := n.resolveConfigVariant()
2947: +	tmpl, tplName := getTemplateForVariant(v, tplData.SwVersion)
2948: +	return template.New(tplName).
2949: +		Funcs(clabutils.CreateFuncs()).
2950: +		Parse(tmpl)
2951: +}

1: #!/bin/bash
2: 
3: # first extract chassis info file from srsim then use the script to update the schema enums.
4: 
5: CHASSIS_INFO_FILE=chassis_info.json
6: SCHEMA=../schemas/clab.schema.json
7: 
8: jq --indent 4 -s '
9:   .[0] as $all |
10:   .[1] |
11:   ([.. | objects | select(.enum? and (.enum | index("ixr-e2n"))) | .enum][0]) as $node_types |
12:   ($all | with_entries(select((.key | ascii_downcase) as $key | $node_types | index($key)))) as $c |
13:   ($c | [.[].cpm // [] | .[]] + [.[].fixed_hw_cfg // empty]) as $cpms |
14:   ($c | [.[].iom // [] | .[]] + [.[].fixed_hw_cfg // empty]) as $cards |
15:   ($c | [.[].sfm // [] | .[]]) as $sfms |
16:   ($c | [.[].mda // [] | .[] | select(. != null)] + [.[].fixed_mdas // {} | .[]]) as $mdas |
17:   ($c | [.[].xiom // [] | .[]]) as $xioms |
18: 
19:   .definitions["sros-cpm-types"].enum |= (. + $cpms | unique | sort) |
20:   .definitions["sros-card-types"].enum |= (. + $cards | unique | sort) |
21:   .definitions["sros-sfm-types"].enum |= (. + $sfms | unique | sort) |
22:   .definitions["sros-mda-types"].enum |= (. + $mdas | unique | sort) |
23:   .definitions["sros-xiom-types"].enum |= (. + $xioms | unique | sort)
24: ' "$CHASSIS_INFO_FILE" "$SCHEMA" > "$SCHEMA.tmp"
25: 
26: mv "$SCHEMA.tmp" "$SCHEMA"

(End of file - total 26 lines)

1: // Copyright 2025 Nokia
2: // Licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License.
3: // SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause
4: 
5: package sros
6: 
7: import (
8: 	"encoding/json"
9: 	"fmt"
10: 	"slices"
11: 	"strconv"
12: 	"strings"
13: )
14: 
15: // DefaultChassisInfoPath is the path to chassis_info.json inside SROS/SR SIM container images.
16: const DefaultChassisInfoPath = "/opt/nokia/chassis_info.json"
17: 
18: // chassisInfoFileLicense is prepended to the chassis_info.json file written to LabDir.
19: const chassisInfoFileLicense = "// Copyright 2026 Nokia\n// Licensed under the BSD 3-Clause License.\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause\n\n"
20: 
21: type chassisInfoEntry struct {
22: 	Alias      string            `json:"alias"`
23: 	CPM        []string          `json:"cpm"`
24: 	IOM        []string          `json:"iom"`
25: 	IOMSlots   int               `json:"iom_slots"`
26: 	MDA        []*string         `json:"mda"`
27: 	FixedMDAs  map[string]string `json:"fixed_mdas"`
28: 	SFM        []string          `json:"sfm"`
29: 	XIOM       []string          `json:"xiom"`
30: 	FixedHWCfg string            `json:"fixed_hw_cfg"`
31: 	Integrated bool              `json:"integrated"`
32: 	Redundant  bool              `json:"redundant"`
33: }
34: 
35: type chassisInfo map[string]chassisInfoEntry
36: 
37: func parseChassisInfo(content []byte) (chassisInfo, error) {
38: 	var info chassisInfo
39: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &info); err != nil {
40: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse chassis_info.json: %w", err)
41: 	}
42: 	return info, nil
43: }
44: 
45: func (i chassisInfo) entry(nodeType string) (chassisInfoEntry, bool) {
46: 	key := ""
47: 	for candidate := range i {
48: 		if strings.EqualFold(candidate, strings.TrimSpace(nodeType)) {
49: 			key = candidate
50: 			break
51: 		}
52: 	}
53: 	if key == "" {
54: 		return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
58: 	for {
59: 		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
60: 			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
61: 		}
62: 		seen[key] = struct{}{}
63: 
64: 		entry := i[key]
65: 		if entry.Alias == "" {
66: 			return entry, true
67: 		}
68: 
69: 		key = ""
70: 		for candidate := range i {
71: 			if strings.EqualFold(candidate, entry.Alias) {
72: 				key = candidate
73: 				break
74: 			}
75: 		}
76: 		if key == "" {
77: 			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
78: 		}
79: 	}
80: }
81: 
82: // componentWarnings returns best-effort validation warnings. It deliberately skips checks
83: // that chassis_info.json cannot express, such as which MDA types belong under a specific XIOM.
84: func (i chassisInfo) componentWarnings(nodeType, sfm string, components []*Component) []string {
85: 	entry, ok := i.entry(nodeType)
86: 	if !ok {
87: 		return []string{
88: 			fmt.Sprintf(
89: 				"chassis type %q is not present in chassis_info.json; component compatibility was not checked",
90: 				nodeType,
91: 			),
92: 		}
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	var warnings []string
96: 	if sfm != "" && len(entry.SFM) > 0 && !slices.Contains(entry.SFM, sfm) {
97: 		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
98: 			"SFM type %q is not listed for chassis type %q",
99: 			sfm,
100: 			nodeType,
101: 		))
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	for _, component := range components {
105: 		if component == nil {
106: 			continue
107: 		}
108: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))
109: 		if slot == "" {
110: 			slot = slotAName
111: 		}
112: 
113: 		switch {
114: 		case slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName:
115: 			if slot == slotBName && !entry.Redundant {
116: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
117: 					"component slot %s is not listed as supported for chassis type %q",
118: 					slot,
119: 					nodeType,
120: 				))
121: 			}
122: 			if component.Type != "" &&
123: 				entry.FixedHWCfg != "" &&
124: 				component.Type != entry.FixedHWCfg {
125: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
126: 					"component type %q in slot %s does not match fixed hardware %q for chassis type %q",
127: 					component.Type,
128: 					slot,
129: 					entry.FixedHWCfg,
130: 					nodeType,
131: 				))
132: 			} else if component.Type != "" &&
133: 				entry.FixedHWCfg == "" &&
134: 				len(entry.CPM) > 0 &&
135: 				!slices.Contains(entry.CPM, component.Type) {
136: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
137: 					"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
138: 					component.Type,
139: 					slot,
140: 					nodeType,
141: 				))
142: 			}
143: 		default:
144: 			numericSlot, err := strconv.Atoi(slot)
145: 			if err == nil {
146: 				if entry.IOMSlots > 0 && numericSlot > entry.IOMSlots {
147: 					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
148: 						"component slot %s exceeds the %d IOM slots listed for chassis type %q",
149: 						slot,
150: 						entry.IOMSlots,
151: 						nodeType,
152: 					))
153: 				}
154: 				if component.Type != "" &&
155: 					len(entry.IOM) > 0 &&
156: 					!slices.Contains(entry.IOM, component.Type) {
157: 					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
158: 						"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
159: 						component.Type,
160: 						slot,
161: 						nodeType,
162: 					))
163: 				}
164: 			}
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		for _, xiom := range component.XIOM {
168: 			if xiom.Type != "" &&
169: 				len(entry.XIOM) > 0 &&
170: 				!slices.Contains(entry.XIOM, xiom.Type) {
171: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
172: 					"XIOM type %q in component slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
173: 					xiom.Type,
174: 					slot,
175: 					nodeType,
176: 				))
177: 			}
178: 		}
179: 
180: 		if entry.Integrated || (slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName) {
181: 			warnings = append(warnings, validateMDAs(nodeType, entry, component.MDA)...)
182: 		}
183: 	}
184: 
185: 	return warnings
186: }
187: 
188: func validateMDAs(nodeType string, entry chassisInfoEntry, mdas MDAS) []string {
189: 	var warnings []string
190: 	for _, mda := range mdas {
191: 		if fixed, exists := entry.FixedMDAs[strconv.Itoa(mda.Slot)]; exists {
192: 			if mda.Type != fixed {
193: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
194: 					"MDA type %q in slot %d does not match fixed MDA %q for chassis type %q",
195: 					mda.Type,
196: 					mda.Slot,
197: 					fixed,
198: 					nodeType,
199: 				))
200: 			}
201: 			continue
202: 		}
203: 		if mda.Type != "" && !containsChassisType(entry.MDA, mda.Type) {
204: 			warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
205: 				"MDA type %q in slot %d is not listed for chassis type %q",
206: 				mda.Type,
207: 				mda.Slot,
208: 				nodeType,
209: 			))
210: 		}
211: 	}
212: 	return warnings
213: }
214: 
215: func containsChassisType(types []*string, value string) bool {
216: 	for _, typ := range types {
217: 		if typ != nil && *typ == value {
218: 			return true
219: 		}
220: 	}
221: 	return false
222: }

22: func componentsBySlot(components []*Component) map[string]Component {
23: 	m := make(map[string]Component, len(components))
24: 
25: 	for i, c := range components {

27: 			continue

30: 		norm := *c

128: func setComponentEnvVars(env map[string]string, c *Component) {
129: 	if c.Type != "" {
130: 		env[envNokiaSrosCard] = c.Type
131: 	}
132: 
133: 	for _, x := range c.XIOM {
134: 		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_X%d", envNokiaSrosXIOM, x.Slot)

137: 		for _, m := range x.MDA {
138: 			key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_X%d_%d", envNokiaSrosMDA, x.Slot, m.Slot)
139: 			env[key] = m.Type
140: 		}
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	for _, m := range c.MDA {
144: 		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d", envNokiaSrosMDA, m.Slot)
145: 		env[key] = m.Type
146: 	}
147: }

149: func (n *sros) checkComponentSlotsConfig() error {
150: 	// check Slots are unique
151: 	componentNames := map[string]struct{}{}
152: 	for _, component := range n.kindSpecificCfg().Components {
153: 		// convert slot to upper
154: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(component.Slot)
155: 		// check if slot exists
156: 		_, exists := componentNames[slot]
157: 		if exists {
158: 			return fmt.Errorf(
159: 				"node %s slot %s duplicate definition",
160: 				n.GetShortName(),
161: 				component.Slot,
162: 			)
163: 		}
164: 		// add to component names map
165: 		componentNames[slot] = struct{}{}
166: 
167: 	}
168: 	return nil
169: }

171: // componentDerivedEnv is the environment a component would set from its type, XIOM, MDA,
172: // and per-component env. Per-component env overrides the typed fields.
173: func componentDerivedEnv(c *Component) map[string]string {
174: 	derived := map[string]string{}
175: 	if c == nil {
176: 		return derived
177: 	}
178: 	setComponentEnvVars(derived, c)
179: 	maps.Copy(derived, c.Env)
180: 	return derived
181: }

183: // warnUserEnvOverrides logs when a node env var replaces a component-derived value.
184: func warnUserEnvOverrides(node string, derived, userEnv map[string]string) {
185: 	for key, componentValue := range derived {
186: 		envValue, userSet := userEnv[key]
187: 		if !userSet || componentValue == envValue {
188: 			continue
189: 		}
190: 		log.Warn(
191: 			fmt.Sprintf(
192: 				"component value %q will not be used because environment variable %s is set",
193: 				componentValue,
194: 				key,
195: 			),
196: 			"node", node,
197: 			"env", key,
198: 			"component-value", componentValue,
199: 			"env-value", envValue,
200: 		)
201: 	}
202: }
203: 
204: // keepUserEnv copies component-derived keys into dst unless the user already set that key.
205: // A user value wins, and a differing component value is logged.
206: func keepUserEnv(node string, dst, derived, userEnv map[string]string) {
207: 	warnUserEnvOverrides(node, derived, userEnv)
208: 	for key, componentValue := range derived {
209: 		if envValue, userSet := userEnv[key]; userSet {
210: 			dst[key] = envValue
211: 			continue
212: 		}
213: 		dst[key] = componentValue
214: 	}
215: }

217: // cloneComponent returns a deep copy of c suitable for env overrides during config generation.
218: func cloneComponent(c *Component) *Component {
219: 	if c == nil {
220: 		return &Component{}
221: 	}
222: 	out := *c
223: 	out.Env = maps.Clone(c.Env)
224: 	out.MDA = slices.Clone(c.MDA)
225: 	if len(c.XIOM) > 0 {
226: 		out.XIOM = make(XIOMS, len(c.XIOM))
227: 		for i, xiom := range c.XIOM {
228: 			xiom.MDA = slices.Clone(xiom.MDA)
229: 			out.XIOM[i] = xiom
230: 		}
231: 	}
232: 	return &out
233: }

235: // applyHardwareEnv overlays SR-SIM card, XIOM, and MDA environment variables onto c.
236: // NOKIA_SROS_SLOT is left unchanged; it identifies the container rather than provisioned hardware.
237: func applyHardwareEnv(c *Component, env map[string]string) {
238: 	if c == nil || len(env) == 0 {
239: 		return
240: 	}
241: 	if card := env[envNokiaSrosCard]; card != "" {
242: 		c.Type = card
243: 	}
244: 	for key, val := range env {
245: 		if val == "" {
246: 			continue
247: 		}
248: 		switch {
249: 		case strings.HasPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_X"):
250: 			rest := strings.TrimPrefix(key, envNokiaSrosMDA+"_X")
251: 			xiomStr, mdaStr, ok := strings.Cut(rest, "_")
252: 			if !ok {
253: 				continue
254: 			}
255: 			xiomSlot, errX := strconv.Atoi(xiomStr)
256: 			mdaSlot, errM := strconv.Atoi(mdaStr)
257: 			if errX != nil || errM != nil || xiomSlot <= 0 || mdaSlot <= 0 {
258: 				continue
259: 			}

105: // componentCfgLine represents one SR OS config line for a component (card, sfm, xiom, mda).
