115: // String returns the SR OS CLI config line for this component.
116: func (l componentCfgLine) String() string {
117: 	switch l.Kind {
118: 	case "card":
119: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s card-type %s admin-state enable\n", l.Slot, l.Type)
120: 	case "sfm":
121: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure sfm %s sfm-type %s admin-state enable\n", l.Slot, l.Type)
122: 	case "xiom":
123: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s xiom x%d xiom-type %s admin-state enable\n",
124: 			l.Slot, l.XiomSlot, l.Type)
125: 	case "xiomMda":
126: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s xiom x%d mda %d mda-type %s admin-state enable\n",
127: 			l.Slot, l.XiomSlot, l.MdaSlot, l.Type)
128: 	case "mda":
129: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s mda %d mda-type %s admin-state enable\n",
130: 			l.Slot, l.MdaSlot, l.Type)
131: 	default:
132: 		return ""
133: 	}
134: }

136: // buildComponentCfgLines turns root components into a slice of config lines (card, sfm, xiom,
137: // xiomMda, mda).
138: // CPM slots (A, B) are skipped. Components without Type are skipped (caller may log).
139: func buildComponentCfgLines(components []*Component, sfm string) []componentCfgLine {
140: 	var lines []componentCfgLine
141: 	for _, component := range components {
142: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))
143: 		if slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName {
144: 			continue
145: 		}
146: 		if component.Type == "" {
147: 			continue
148: 		}
149: 		lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{Kind: "card", Slot: slot, Type: component.Type})
150: 		if sfm != "" {
151: 			lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{Kind: "sfm", Slot: slot, Type: sfm})
152: 		}
153: 		for _, xiom := range component.XIOM {
154: 			if xiom.Type != "" {
155: 				lines = append(
156: 					lines,
157: 					componentCfgLine{
158: 						Kind:     "xiom",
159: 						Slot:     slot,
160: 						Type:     xiom.Type,
161: 						XiomSlot: xiom.Slot,
162: 					},
163: 				)
164: 			}
165: 			for _, mda := range xiom.MDA {
166: 				if mda.Type != "" {
167: 					lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{
168: 						Kind: "xiomMda", Slot: slot, Type: mda.Type,
169: 						XiomSlot: xiom.Slot, MdaSlot: mda.Slot,
170: 					})
171: 				}
172: 			}
173: 		}
174: 		for _, mda := range component.MDA {
175: 			if mda.Type != "" {
176: 				lines = append(
177: 					lines,
178: 					componentCfgLine{Kind: "mda", Slot: slot, Type: mda.Type, MdaSlot: mda.Slot},
179: 				)
180: 			}
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 	return lines
184: }

186: func buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(nodeType string, override *Component) []componentCfgLine {
187: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefaultComponents[canonicalSrosNodeType(nodeType)]
188: 	if !ok {
189: 		return nil
190: 	}
191: 	if override == nil {
192: 		override = &Component{}
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	defaultMdas := component.mdas
196: 
197: 	if len(override.XIOM) > 0 {
198: 		defaultMdas = nil
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	card := &Component{
202: 		Slot: integratedSrosCardSlot,
203: 		Type: component.cardType,
204: 		XIOM: override.XIOM,
205: 		MDA:  mergeIntegratedMdas(defaultMdas, override.MDA),
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	return buildComponentCfgLines([]*Component{card}, "")
209: }

211: func mergeIntegratedMdas(defaults, overrides MDAS) MDAS {
212: 	bySlot := map[int]string{}
213: 	for _, mda := range slices.Concat(defaults, overrides) {
214: 		if mda.Slot > 0 && mda.Type != "" {
215: 			bySlot[mda.Slot] = mda.Type
216: 		}
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	slots := slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(bySlot))
220: 	mdas := make(MDAS, 0, len(slots))
221: 	for _, slot := range slots {
222: 		mdas = append(mdas, MDA{Slot: slot, Type: bySlot[slot]})
223: 	}
224: 	return mdas
225: }

249: func isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents(nodeType string, components []*Component) bool {
250: 	if !isIntegratedSrosNodeType(nodeType) || len(components) < 2 {
251: 		return false
252: 	}
253: 	for _, c := range components {

257: 	}
258: 	return true

263: 	if slot == "" {
264: 		slot = standaloneSlotName
265: 	}
266: 	return slices.Contains(integratedSrosAllowedSlots(nodeType), slot)
267: }

269: func (n *sros) generateComponentConfig() string {
270: 	if !n.kindSpecificCfg().GenComponentConfig {
271: 		return ""
272: 	}
273: 	if n.isConfigClassic() {
274: 		return ""
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	if isIntegratedSrosNodeType(n.Cfg.NodeType) {
278: 		return n.generateIntegratedComponentConfig()
279: 	}
280: 
281: 	components := n.rootComponents
282: 	if len(components) == 0 {
283: 		return ""
284: 	}
285: 
286: 	for _, c := range components {
287: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(c.Slot))
288: 		if slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName {
289: 			continue
290: 		}
291: 		if c.Type == "" {
292: 			log.Warn(
293: 				"SR-SIM node has no type set for component in slot, skipping component SR OS config generation.",
294: 				"node",
295: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
296: 				"slot",
297: 				slot,
298: 			)
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	lines := buildComponentCfgLines(n.componentsForConfig(components), n.componentSFM())
303: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
304: }

306: // hardwareEnv is the topology env, which overrides component type, XIOM, and MDA.
307: // Nodes that have not been through Init expose that env on Cfg.Env.
308: func (n *sros) hardwareEnv() map[string]string {
309: 	if n.userEnv != nil {
310: 		return n.userEnv
311: 	}
312: 	return n.Cfg.Env
313: }

315: // componentSFM is the SFM used in generated config. NOKIA_SROS_SFM overrides the sfm key.
316: func (n *sros) componentSFM() string {
317: 	if sfm := n.hardwareEnv()[envNokiaSrosSFM]; sfm != "" {
318: 		return sfm
319: 	}
320: 	return n.kindSpecificCfg().SFM
321: }

323: // componentForConfig clones c and applies per-component env, then node env.
324: func (n *sros) componentForConfig(c *Component) *Component {
325: 	out := cloneComponent(c)
326: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, out.Env)
327: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, n.hardwareEnv())
328: 	return out
329: }

331: func (n *sros) componentsForConfig(components []*Component) []*Component {
332: 	out := make([]*Component, len(components))
333: 	for i, c := range components {
334: 		out[i] = n.componentForConfig(c)
335: 	}
336: 	return out
337: }

339: func (n *sros) componentConfigFromLines(lines []componentCfgLine) string {
340: 	powerConfig := n.generatePowerConfig()
341: 	if len(lines) == 0 && powerConfig == "" {
342: 		return ""
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	var config strings.Builder
346: 	for _, l := range lines {
347: 		config.WriteString(l.String())
348: 	}
349: 	config.WriteString(powerConfig)
350: 	return config.String()
351: }

353: func (n *sros) generateIntegratedComponentConfig() string {
354: 	card := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosCard])
355: 	if card != "" {
356: 		log.Info(
357: 			"Card type override set on integrated chassis type, skipping component SR OS config generation",
358: 			"node",
359: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
360: 			"type",
361: 			n.Cfg.NodeType,
362: 			"card",
363: 			card,
364: 		)
365: 		return ""
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	lines := buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(
369: 		n.Cfg.NodeType,
370: 		n.componentForConfig(n.integratedComponentOverride()),
371: 	)
372: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
373: }

375: // integratedComponentOverride returns the component that overrides the integrated defaults:
376: // the single component of a standalone node, or the component matching the slot of a
377: // redundant CPM node.
378: func (n *sros) integratedComponentOverride() *Component {
379: 	if n.rootCtrName == "" {
380: 		if len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) == 1 {
381: 			return n.kindSpecificCfg().Components[0]
382: 		}
383: 		return nil
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	slot := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]
387: 	for _, c := range n.rootComponents {
388: 		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(c.Slot), slot) {
389: 			return c
390: 		}
391: 	}

2004: +// warnUnsupportedComponents validates the effective component configuration against the
2005: +// chassis_info.json extracted from this exact image. Validation is advisory and never blocks
2006: +// deploy.
2007: +func (n *sros) warnUnsupportedComponents(content []byte) {
2008: +	// A distributed node validates once, from CPM A, to avoid duplicate warnings from CPM B.
2009: +	if !n.isStandaloneNode() && !n.isCPM(slotAName) {
2010: +		return
2011: +	}
2012: +
2013: +	info, err := parseChassisInfo(content)
2014: +	if err != nil {
2015: +		log.Warn("Could not validate SR-SIM components against chassis_info.json",
2016: +			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName, "error", err)
2017: +		return
2018: +	}
2019: +
2020: +	components := n.rootComponents
2021: +	if len(components) == 0 {
2022: +		components = n.kindSpecificCfg().Components
2023: +	}
2024: +
2025: +	effective := n.componentsForConfig(components)
2026: +	if len(effective) == 0 {
2027: +		// Environment variables can configure integrated hardware without a components entry.
2028: +		effective = []*Component{n.componentForConfig(nil)}
2029: +	}
2030: +
2031: +	nodeType := n.Cfg.NodeType
2032: +	if chassis := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosChassis]); chassis != "" {
2033: +		nodeType = chassis
2034: +	}
2035: +	for _, warning := range info.componentWarnings(nodeType, n.componentSFM(), effective) {
2036: +		log.Warn("SR-SIM component configuration may not be supported",
2037: +			"node", n.Cfg.ShortName,
2038: +			"chassis", nodeType,
2039: +			"warning", warning)
2040: +	}
2041: +}

2419:  func (n *sros) tlsCertBootstrap(ctx context.Context, addr string) error {

21: type chassisInfoEntry struct {
22: 	Alias      string            `json:"alias"`
23: 	CPM        []string          `json:"cpm"`
24: 	IOM        []string          `json:"iom"`
25: 	IOMSlots   int               `json:"iom_slots"`
26: 	MDA        []*string         `json:"mda"`

28: 	SFM        []string          `json:"sfm"`

33: }

35: type chassisInfo map[string]chassisInfoEntry
36: 
37: func parseChassisInfo(content []byte) (chassisInfo, error) {
38: 	var info chassisInfo
39: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(content, &info); err != nil {
40: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse chassis_info.json: %w", err)
41: 	}
42: 	return info, nil
43: }
44: 
45: func (i chassisInfo) entry(nodeType string) (chassisInfoEntry, bool) {
46: 	key := ""
47: 	for candidate := range i {
48: 		if strings.EqualFold(candidate, strings.TrimSpace(nodeType)) {
49: 			key = candidate
50: 			break
51: 		}
52: 	}
53: 	if key == "" {
54: 		return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
58: 	for {
59: 		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
60: 			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
61: 		}
62: 		seen[key] = struct{}{}
63: 
64: 		entry := i[key]
65: 		if entry.Alias == "" {
66: 			return entry, true
67: 		}
68: 
69: 		key = ""
70: 		for candidate := range i {
71: 			if strings.EqualFold(candidate, entry.Alias) {
72: 				key = candidate
73: 				break
74: 			}
75: 		}
76: 		if key == "" {
77: 			return chassisInfoEntry{}, false
78: 		}
79: 	}
80: }

83: // that chassis_info.json cannot express, such as which MDA types belong under a specific XIOM.
84: func (i chassisInfo) componentWarnings(nodeType, sfm string, components []*Component) []string {
85: 	entry, ok := i.entry(nodeType)
86: 	if !ok {
87: 		return []string{
88: 			fmt.Sprintf(
89: 				"chassis type %q is not present in chassis_info.json; component compatibility was not checked",
90: 				nodeType,
91: 			),
92: 		}
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	var warnings []string
96: 	if sfm != "" && len(entry.SFM) > 0 && !slices.Contains(entry.SFM, sfm) {
97: 		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
98: 			"SFM type %q is not listed for chassis type %q",
99: 			sfm,
100: 			nodeType,
101: 		))
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	for _, component := range components {
105: 		if component == nil {
106: 			continue
107: 		}
108: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))
109: 		if slot == "" {
110: 			slot = slotAName
111: 		}
112: 
113: 		switch {
114: 		case slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName:
115: 			if slot == slotBName && !entry.Redundant {
116: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
117: 					"component slot %s is not listed as supported for chassis type %q",
118: 					slot,
119: 					nodeType,
120: 				))
121: 			}
122: 			if component.Type != "" &&
123: 				entry.FixedHWCfg != "" &&
124: 				component.Type != entry.FixedHWCfg {
125: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
126: 					"component type %q in slot %s does not match fixed hardware %q for chassis type %q",
127: 					component.Type,
128: 					slot,
129: 					entry.FixedHWCfg,
130: 					nodeType,
131: 				))
132: 			} else if component.Type != "" &&
133: 				entry.FixedHWCfg == "" &&
134: 				len(entry.CPM) > 0 &&
135: 				!slices.Contains(entry.CPM, component.Type) {
136: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
137: 					"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
138: 					component.Type,
139: 					slot,
140: 					nodeType,
141: 				))
142: 			}
143: 		default:
144: 			numericSlot, err := strconv.Atoi(slot)
145: 			if err == nil {
146: 				if entry.IOMSlots > 0 && numericSlot > entry.IOMSlots {
147: 					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
148: 						"component slot %s exceeds the %d IOM slots listed for chassis type %q",
149: 						slot,
150: 						entry.IOMSlots,
151: 						nodeType,
152: 					))
153: 				}
154: 				if component.Type != "" &&
155: 					len(entry.IOM) > 0 &&
156: 					!slices.Contains(entry.IOM, component.Type) {
157: 					warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
158: 						"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
159: 						component.Type,
160: 						slot,
161: 						nodeType,
162: 					))
163: 				}
164: 			}
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		for _, xiom := range component.XIOM {
168: 			if xiom.Type != "" &&
169: 				len(entry.XIOM) > 0 &&
170: 				!slices.Contains(entry.XIOM, xiom.Type) {
171: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
172: 					"XIOM type %q in component slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q",
173: 					xiom.Type,
174: 					slot,
175: 					nodeType,
176: 				))
177: 			}
178: 		}
179: 
180: 		if entry.Integrated || (slot != slotAName && slot != slotBName) {
181: 			warnings = append(warnings, validateMDAs(nodeType, entry, component.MDA)...)
182: 		}
183: 	}
184: 
185: 	return warnings
186: }
187: 
188: func validateMDAs(nodeType string, entry chassisInfoEntry, mdas MDAS) []string {
189: 	var warnings []string
190: 	for _, mda := range mdas {
191: 		if fixed, exists := entry.FixedMDAs[strconv.Itoa(mda.Slot)]; exists {
192: 			if mda.Type != fixed {
193: 				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
194: 					"MDA type %q in slot %d does not match fixed MDA %q for chassis type %q",
195: 					mda.Type,
196: 					mda.Slot,
197: 					fixed,
198: 					nodeType,
199: 				))
200: 			}
201: 			continue
202: 		}
203: 		if mda.Type != "" && !containsChassisType(entry.MDA, mda.Type) {
204: 			warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(
205: 				"MDA type %q in slot %d is not listed for chassis type %q",
206: 				mda.Type,
207: 				mda.Slot,
208: 				nodeType,
209: 			))
210: 		}
211: 	}
212: 	return warnings
213: }
214: 
215: func containsChassisType(types []*string, value string) bool {
216: 	for _, typ := range types {
217: 		if typ != nil && *typ == value {
218: 			return true
219: 		}
220: 	}
221: 	return false
222: }

err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"parse chassis_info.json: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn info, nil\n}\n\nfunc (i chassisInfo) entry(nodeType string) (chassisInfoEntry, bool) {\n\tkey := \"\"\n\tfor candidate := range i {\n\t\tif strings.EqualFold(candidate, strings.TrimSpace(nodeType)) {\n\t\t\tkey = candidate\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif key == \"\" {\n\t\treturn chassisInfoEntry{}, false\n\t}\n\n\tseen := map[string]struct{}{}\n\tfor {\n\t\tif _, ok := seen[key]; ok {\n\t\t\treturn chassisInfoEntry{}, false\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[key] = struct{}{}\n\n\t\tentry := i[key]\n\t\tif entry.Alias == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn entry, true\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tkey = \"\"\n\t\tfor candidate := range i {\n\t\t\tif strings.EqualFold(candidate, entry.Alias) {\n\t\t\t\tkey = candidate\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif key == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn chassisInfoEntry{}, false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// componentWarnings returns best-effort validation warnings. It deliberately skips checks\n// that chassis_info.json cannot express, such as which MDA types belong under a specific XIOM.\nfunc (i chassisInfo) componentWarnings(nodeType, sfm string, components []*Component) []string {\n\tentry, ok := i.entry(nodeType)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn []string{\n\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\"chassis type %q is not present in chassis_info.json; component compatibility was not checked\",\n\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvar warnings []string\n\tif sfm != \"\" && len(entry.SFM) > 0 && !slices.Contains(entry.SFM, sfm) {\n\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\"SFM type %q is not listed for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\tsfm,\n\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t))\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, component := range components {\n\t\tif component == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))\n\t\tif slot == \"\" {\n\t\t\tslot = slotAName\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tswitch {\n\t\tcase slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName:\n\t\t\tif slot == slotBName && !entry.Redundant {\n\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"component slot %s is not listed as supported for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tslot,\n\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif component.Type != \"\" &&\n\t\t\t\tentry.FixedHWCfg != \"\" &&\n\t\t\t\tcomponent.Type != entry.FixedHWCfg {\n\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"component type %q in slot %s does not match fixed hardware %q for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcomponent.Type,\n\t\t\t\t\tslot,\n\t\t\t\t\tentry.FixedHWCfg,\n\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t} else if component.Type != \"\" &&\n\t\t\t\tentry.FixedHWCfg == \"\" &&\n\t\t\t\tlen(entry.CPM) > 0 &&\n\t\t\t\t!slices.Contains(entry.CPM, component.Type) {\n\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcomponent.Type,\n\t\t\t\t\tslot,\n\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tnumericSlot, err := strconv.Atoi(slot)\n\t\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t\tif entry.IOMSlots > 0 && numericSlot > entry.IOMSlots {\n\t\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"component slot %s exceeds the %d IOM slots listed for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tslot,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tentry.IOMSlots,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif component.Type != \"\" &&\n\t\t\t\t\tlen(entry.IOM) > 0 &&\n\t\t\t\t\t!slices.Contains(entry.IOM, component.Type) {\n\t\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"component type %q in slot %s is not listed for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcomponent.Type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tslot,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tfor _, xiom := range component.XIOM {\n\t\t\tif xiom.Type != \"\" append(warnings, validateMDAs(nodeType, entry, component.MDA)...)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn warnings\n}\n\nfunc validateMDAs(nodeType string, entry chassisInfoEntry, mdas MDAS) []string {\n\tvar warnings []string\n\tfor _, mda := range mdas {\n\t\tif fixed, exists := entry.FixedMDAs[strconv.Itoa(mda.Slot)]; exists {\n\t\t\tif mda.Type != fixed {\n\t\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"MDA type %q in slot %d does not match fixed MDA %q for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tmda.Type,\n\t\t\t\t\tmda.Slot,\n\t\t\t\t\tfixed,\n\t\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif mda.Type != \"\" && !containsChassisType(entry.MDA, mda.Type) {\n\t\t\twarnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t\t\t\"MDA type %q in slot %d is not listed for chassis type %q\",\n\t\t\t\tmda.Type,\n\t\t\t\tmda.Slot,\n\t\t\t\tnodeType,\n\t\t\t))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn warnings\n}\n\nfunc containsChassisType(types []*string, value string) bool {\n\tfor _, typ := range types {\n\t\tif typ != nil && *typ == value {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}",

105: // componentCfgLine represents one SR OS config line for a component (card, sfm, xiom, mda).
106: // Adding a new component type = add a Kind and a case in String().
107: type componentCfgLine struct {
108: 	Kind     string // "card", "sfm", "xiom", "xiomMda", "mda"
109: 	Slot     string
110: 	Type     string
111: 	XiomSlot int
112: 	MdaSlot  int
113: }
114: 
115: // String returns the SR OS CLI config line for this component.
116: func (l componentCfgLine) String() string {
117: 	switch l.Kind {
118: 	case "card":
119: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s card-type %s admin-state enable\n", l.Slot, l.Type)
120: 	case "sfm":
121: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure sfm %s sfm-type %s admin-state enable\n", l.Slot, l.Type)
122: 	case "xiom":
123: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s xiom x%d xiom-type %s admin-state enable\n",
124: 			l.Slot, l.XiomSlot, l.Type)
125: 	case "xiomMda":
126: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s xiom x%d mda %d mda-type %s admin-state enable\n",
127: 			l.Slot, l.XiomSlot, l.MdaSlot, l.Type)
128: 	case "mda":
129: 		return fmt.Sprintf("/configure card %s mda %d mda-type %s admin-state enable\n",
130: 			l.Slot, l.MdaSlot, l.Type)
131: 	default:
132: 		return ""
133: 	}
134: }

136: // buildComponentCfgLines turns root components into a slice of config lines (card, sfm, xiom,
137: // xiomMda, mda).
138: // CPM slots (A, B) are skipped. Components without Type are skipped (caller may log).
139: func buildComponentCfgLines(components []*Component, sfm string) []componentCfgLine {
140: 	var lines []componentCfgLine
141: 	for _, component := range components {
142: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(component.Slot))
143: 		if slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName {
144: 			continue
145: 		}
146: 		if component.Type == "" {
147: 			continue
148: 		}
149: 		lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{Kind: "card", Slot: slot, Type: component.Type})
150: 		if sfm != "" {
151: 			lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{Kind: "sfm", Slot: slot, Type: sfm})
152: 		}
153: 		for _, xiom := range component.XIOM {
154: 			if xiom.Type != "" {
155: 				lines = append(
156: 					lines,
157: 					componentCfgLine{
158: 						Kind:     "xiom",
159: 						Slot:     slot,
160: 						Type:     xiom.Type,
161: 						XiomSlot: xiom.Slot,
162: 					},
163: 				)
164: 			}
165: 			for _, mda := range xiom.MDA {
166: 				if mda.Type != "" {
167: 					lines = append(lines, componentCfgLine{
168: 						Kind: "xiomMda", Slot: slot, Type: mda.Type,
169: 						XiomSlot: xiom.Slot, MdaSlot: mda.Slot,
170: 					})
171: 				}
172: 			}
173: 		}
174: 		for _, mda := range component.MDA {
175: 			if mda.Type != "" {
176: 				lines = append(
177: 					lines,
178: 					componentCfgLine{Kind: "mda", Slot: slot, Type: mda.Type, MdaSlot: mda.Slot},
179: 				)
180: 			}
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 	return lines
184: }

186: func buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(nodeType string, override *Component) []componentCfgLine {
187: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefaultComponents[canonicalSrosNodeType(nodeType)]
188: 	if !ok {
189: 		return nil
190: 	}
191: 	if override == nil {
192: 		override = &Component{}
193: 	}
194: 
195: 	defaultMdas := component.mdas
196: 
197: 	if len(override.XIOM) > 0 {
198: 		defaultMdas = nil
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	card := &Component{
202: 		Slot: integratedSrosCardSlot,
203: 		Type: component.cardType,
204: 		XIOM: override.XIOM,
205: 		MDA:  mergeIntegratedMdas(defaultMdas, override.MDA),
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	return buildComponentCfgLines([]*Component{card}, "")
209: }
210: 
211: func mergeIntegratedMdas(defaults, overrides MDAS) MDAS {
212: 	bySlot := map[int]string{}
213: 	for _, mda := range slices.Concat(defaults, overrides) {
214: 		if mda.Slot > 0 && mda.Type != "" {
215: 			bySlot[mda.Slot] = mda.Type
216: 		}
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	slots := slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(bySlot))
220: 	mdas := make(MDAS, 0, len(slots))
221: 	for _, slot := range slots {
222: 		mdas = append(mdas, MDA{Slot: slot, Type: bySlot[slot]})
223: 	}
224: 	return mdas
225: }

228: 	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(nodeType))

231: func integratedSrosDefault(nodeType string) (integratedSrosDefaultComponent, bool) {
232: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefaultComponents[canonicalSrosNodeType(nodeType)]
233: 	return component, ok

236: func isIntegratedSrosNodeType(nodeType string) bool {

241: func integratedSrosAllowedSlots(nodeType string) []string {
242: 	component, ok := integratedSrosDefault(nodeType)
243: 	if !ok || len(component.allowedSlots) == 0 {
244: 		return []string{slotAName}
245: 	}
246: 	return component.allowedSlots

249: func isRedundantIntegratedSrosComponents(nodeType string, components []*Component) bool {
250: 	if !isIntegratedSrosNodeType(nodeType) || len(components) < 2 {
251: 		return false
252: 	}
253: 	for _, c := range components {
254: 		if strings.TrimSpace(c.Slot) == "" || !integratedSrosSlotAllowed(nodeType, c.Slot) {
255: 			return false
256: 		}
257: 	}
258: 	return true
259: }

261: func integratedSrosSlotAllowed(nodeType, slot string) bool {
262: 	slot = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(slot))
263: 	if slot == "" {
264: 		slot = standaloneSlotName
265: 	}
266: 	return slices.Contains(integratedSrosAllowedSlots(nodeType), slot)
267: }

269: func (n *sros) generateComponentConfig() string {
270: 	if !n.kindSpecificCfg().GenComponentConfig {
271: 		return ""
272: 	}
273: 	if n.isConfigClassic() {
274: 		return ""
275: 	}
276: 
277: 	if isIntegratedSrosNodeType(n.Cfg.NodeType) {
278: 		return n.generateIntegratedComponentConfig()
279: 	}
280: 
281: 	components := n.rootComponents
282: 	if len(components) == 0 {
283: 		return ""
284: 	}
285: 
286: 	for _, c := range components {
287: 		slot := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(c.Slot))
288: 		if slot == slotAName || slot == slotBName {
289: 			continue
290: 		}
291: 		if c.Type == "" {
292: 			log.Warn(
293: 				"SR-SIM node has no type set for component in slot, skipping component SR OS config generation.",
294: 				"node",
295: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
296: 				"slot",
297: 				slot,
298: 			)
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 
302: 	lines := buildComponentCfgLines(n.componentsForConfig(components), n.componentSFM())
303: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
304: }

306: // hardwareEnv is the topology env, which overrides component type, XIOM, and MDA.
307: // Nodes that have not been through Init expose that env on Cfg.Env.
308: func (n *sros) hardwareEnv() map[string]string {
309: 	if n.userEnv != nil {
310: 		return n.userEnv
311: 	}
312: 	return n.Cfg.Env
313: }
314: 
315: // componentSFM is the SFM used in generated config. NOKIA_SROS_SFM overrides the sfm key.
316: func (n *sros) componentSFM() string {
317: 	if sfm := n.hardwareEnv()[envNokiaSrosSFM]; sfm != "" {
318: 		return sfm
319: 	}
320: 	return n.kindSpecificCfg().SFM
321: }
322: 
323: // componentForConfig clones c and applies per-component env, then node env.
324: func (n *sros) componentForConfig(c *Component) *Component {
325: 	out := cloneComponent(c)
326: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, out.Env)
327: 	applyHardwareEnv(out, n.hardwareEnv())
328: 	return out
329: }
330: 
331: func (n *sros) componentsForConfig(components []*Component) []*Component {
332: 	out := make([]*Component, len(components))
333: 	for i, c := range components {
334: 		out[i] = n.componentForConfig(c)
335: 	}
336: 	return out
337: }
338: 
339: func (n *sros) componentConfigFromLines(lines []componentCfgLine) string {
340: 	powerConfig := n.generatePowerConfig()
341: 	if len(lines) == 0 && powerConfig == "" {
342: 		return ""
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	var config strings.Builder
346: 	for _, l := range lines {
347: 		config.WriteString(l.String())
348: 	}
349: 	config.WriteString(powerConfig)
350: 	return config.String()
351: }
352: 
353: func (n *sros) generateIntegratedComponentConfig() string {
354: 	card := strings.TrimSpace(n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosCard])
355: 	if card != "" {
356: 		log.Info(
357: 			"Card type override set on integrated chassis type, skipping component SR OS config generation",
358: 			"node",
359: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
360: 			"type",
361: 			n.Cfg.NodeType,
362: 			"card",
363: 			card,
364: 		)
365: 		return ""
366: 	}
367: 
368: 	lines := buildIntegratedComponentCfgLines(
369: 		n.Cfg.NodeType,
370: 		n.componentForConfig(n.integratedComponentOverride()),
371: 	)
372: 	return n.componentConfigFromLines(lines)
373: }

375: // integratedComponentOverride returns the component that overrides the integrated defaults:
376: // the single component of a standalone node, or the component matching the slot of a
377: // redundant CPM node.
378: func (n *sros) integratedComponentOverride() *Component {
379: 	if n.rootCtrName == "" {
380: 		if len(n.kindSpecificCfg().Components) == 1 {
381: 			return n.kindSpecificCfg().Components[0]
382: 		}
383: 		return nil
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	slot := n.Cfg.Env[envNokiaSrosSlot]
387: 	for _, c := range n.rootComponents {
388: 		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(c.Slot), slot) {
389: 			return c
390: 		}
391: 	}
392: 	return nil
393: }
